briefs.title: IG 行業包｜房地產仲介｜案例拆解款×等寬資料頁
briefs.meta: 第 2 輪・2/9 家｜9 張 3:4｜plum-paper · mono-accent · uncoated-paper
briefs.summary: 買家導向行業「房地產仲介」。今天的組合是「案例拆解款」的故事節奏 × 「等寬資料頁」的視覺語法 × plum-paper 配色 × mono-accent 字型配對。一天一個產品：9 張母圖 → 分割 → Canva 上字。

items.purpose: 9 張連續背景帶
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create ONE wide, seamless, TEXT-FREE background plate for an Instagram carousel. It will be machine-split into 9 separate 3:4 cards of 1080×1440 px, so compose it as one continuous horizontal strip that reads left to right (final strip size 9720×1440). Output the widest aspect ratio this tool supports — 16:9 is fine; the strip is fitted afterwards. TEMPLATE FAMILY mono-datasheet+case-teardown｜等寬資料頁・案例拆解款. Design grammar: monospace technical data sheet, thin keylines, small-caps field labels, tabular rhythm, one highlighted row. CONTINUOUS STRUCTURE — this is the whole point of the plate: a continuous fine keyline table grid running the full width with one tinted row band travelling the entire strip. Colourway plum-paper: warm grey paper, deep plum, muted apricot accent. Surface uncoated-paper: matte uncoated paper grain with a barely-visible film grain. Every 1080 px along the strip is a cut line: keep the design either continuous across those cuts or clear of them, and never place a self-contained motif so that it straddles one. Leave broad calm areas with no detail — headlines, body copy and logos are typeset in Canva on top of this plate, and they need somewhere quiet to land.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
NO TEXT OF ANY KIND — no letters, words, numbers, page numbers, headlines, captions, labels, lorem ipsum, fake glyphs, handwriting or signage in any language. No logo, watermark, signature or AI-tool badge. No human figure, face, hand, animal or recognizable branded product. No card borders, frames, crop marks, seam guides, gutters, drop-shadowed panels or anything that reads as a divided grid of separate cards. No phone mockup, no presentation slide, no surrounding canvas. NO PHOTOGRAPHY ANYWHERE ON THE PLATE — no photographic landscape, interior, sky, foliage, texture photo or photo-realistic fill, not even faint, tinted, cropped inside a frame or used as a corner accent. Photo windows must be left EMPTY: draw the frame outline only and leave the inside as the plain paper ground. Photographs are placed in Canva afterwards at full resolution, because the plate is stretched to fit the strip afterwards and any photograph in it smears into pulp. No high-detail focal subject and no illustrated centrepiece — a plate is a stage, not a picture. No hard vignette, heavy noise, neon glow or blown-out highlight that would fight typography.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. This plate is a background only. Text is typeset on top of it later, so more than half of the surface must stay quiet enough to read 36 px body copy against.
2. Compose as one continuous strip. Any structural element — rule, band, path, torn edge, gradient — must run unbroken from the left edge to the right edge.
3. Self-contained motifs must not straddle a cut line. Either repeat them on a rhythm that clears the cuts, or let the design be genuinely continuous instead.
4. Keep contrast low and even along the whole strip: a plate that is dark at one end and pale at the other produces cards that no longer look like a set.
5. Hold one palette and one texture for the entire plate. Colour variation is delivered as a separate colourway plate, not as drift inside one plate.
6. Output the widest aspect ratio the tool offers at the highest available resolution; the strip is fitted and cut afterwards by scripts/split_carousel.py.
7. Detail level matters more than pixel count here: the plate is stretched several times its generated width, which soft texture survives and fine structure does not.
8. PRE-COMPRESS THE GEOMETRY. You can only output about 2.25:1 but the strip is 6.75:1, so everything you draw is stretched roughly 3× wider afterwards. Draw every arch, frame, circle or motif THREE TIMES NARROWER than it should finally look — a tall narrow arch here becomes a correctly-proportioned arch on the card. Horizontal rules and bands are unaffected.
9. ONE MOTIF PER CARD, evenly spaced. If the set is N cards, place exactly N repeats across the strip, each centred in its own 1/N slice, so no card inherits a motif that has drifted off-centre or been split between two cards.
10. No vertical dividing rules between the repeats. A vertical line at a cut turns the swipe into a row of bordered panels, which is the one thing the plate must never look like.

items.purpose: 母圖 → 9 張卡片
items.text:
python3 scripts/split_carousel.py mono-datasheet_case-teardown_plum-paper.png --cards 9
→ 輸出 9 張 1080×1440 卡片 + `_seam_preview.png`。
先看 seam preview：紅帶是每個切點左右各 80px 的禁區，有裝飾或主體被切開就回頭改母圖，不要硬上。
母圖是抽象紋理才用預設 `--fit stretch`；若母圖有拱門、照片框、物件等可辨識結構，改用 `--fit cover`（保幾何但裁掉大部分高度）。

briefs.title: IG 行業包｜攝影師｜教學步驟款×報紙專欄
briefs.meta: 第 2 輪・3/9 家｜9 張 3:4｜dusk-lilac · condensed-impact · laid-textile
briefs.summary: 買家導向行業「攝影師」。今天的組合是「教學步驟款」的故事節奏 × 「報紙專欄」的視覺語法 × dusk-lilac 配色 × condensed-impact 字型配對。一天一個產品：9 張母圖 → 分割 → Canva 上字。

items.purpose: 9 張連續背景帶
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create ONE wide, seamless, TEXT-FREE background plate for an Instagram carousel. It will be machine-split into 9 separate 3:4 cards of 1080×1440 px, so compose it as one continuous horizontal strip that reads left to right (final strip size 9720×1440). Output the widest aspect ratio this tool supports — 16:9 is fine; the strip is fitted afterwards. TEMPLATE FAMILY broadsheet-column+step-path｜報紙專欄・教學步驟款. Design grammar: newspaper broadsheet columns, hairline column rules, drop caps, dense masthead-style headline stack, small photo boxes. CONTINUOUS STRUCTURE — this is the whole point of the plate: unbroken vertical column rules at even spacing across the whole strip with one heavier masthead rule near the top. Colourway dusk-lilac: soft lilac grey, aubergine, pale peach accent. Surface laid-textile: a fine woven textile weave under softly diffused light. Every 1080 px along the strip is a cut line: keep the design either continuous across those cuts or clear of them, and never place a self-contained motif so that it straddles one. Leave broad calm areas with no detail — headlines, body copy and logos are typeset in Canva on top of this plate, and they need somewhere quiet to land.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
NO TEXT OF ANY KIND — no letters, words, numbers, page numbers, headlines, captions, labels, lorem ipsum, fake glyphs, handwriting or signage in any language. No logo, watermark, signature or AI-tool badge. No human figure, face, hand, animal or recognizable branded product. No card borders, frames, crop marks, seam guides, gutters, drop-shadowed panels or anything that reads as a divided grid of separate cards. No phone mockup, no presentation slide, no surrounding canvas. NO PHOTOGRAPHY ANYWHERE ON THE PLATE — no photographic landscape, interior, sky, foliage, texture photo or photo-realistic fill, not even faint, tinted, cropped inside a frame or used as a corner accent. Photo windows must be left EMPTY: draw the frame outline only and leave the inside as the plain paper ground. Photographs are placed in Canva afterwards at full resolution, because the plate is stretched to fit the strip afterwards and any photograph in it smears into pulp. No high-detail focal subject and no illustrated centrepiece — a plate is a stage, not a picture. No hard vignette, heavy noise, neon glow or blown-out highlight that would fight typography.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. This plate is a background only. Text is typeset on top of it later, so more than half of the surface must stay quiet enough to read 36 px body copy against.
2. Compose as one continuous strip. Any structural element — rule, band, path, torn edge, gradient — must run unbroken from the left edge to the right edge.
3. Self-contained motifs must not straddle a cut line. Either repeat them on a rhythm that clears the cuts, or let the design be genuinely continuous instead.
4. Keep contrast low and even along the whole strip: a plate that is dark at one end and pale at the other produces cards that no longer look like a set.
5. Hold one palette and one texture for the entire plate. Colour variation is delivered as a separate colourway plate, not as drift inside one plate.
6. Output the widest aspect ratio the tool offers at the highest available resolution; the strip is fitted and cut afterwards by scripts/split_carousel.py.
7. Detail level matters more than pixel count here: the plate is stretched several times its generated width, which soft texture survives and fine structure does not.
8. PRE-COMPRESS THE GEOMETRY. You can only output about 2.25:1 but the strip is 6.75:1, so everything you draw is stretched roughly 3× wider afterwards. Draw every arch, frame, circle or motif THREE TIMES NARROWER than it should finally look — a tall narrow arch here becomes a correctly-proportioned arch on the card. Horizontal rules and bands are unaffected.
9. ONE MOTIF PER CARD, evenly spaced. If the set is N cards, place exactly N repeats across the strip, each centred in its own 1/N slice, so no card inherits a motif that has drifted off-centre or been split between two cards.
10. No vertical dividing rules between the repeats. A vertical line at a cut turns the swipe into a row of bordered panels, which is the one thing the plate must never look like.

items.purpose: 7 張連續背景帶
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create ONE wide, seamless, TEXT-FREE background plate for an Instagram carousel. It will be machine-split into 7 separate 3:4 cards of 1080×1440 px, so compose it as one continuous horizontal strip that reads left to right (final strip size 7560×1440). Output the widest aspect ratio this tool supports — 16:9 is fine; the strip is fitted afterwards. TEMPLATE FAMILY ticket-stub+faq-concerns｜票券票根・客戶疑慮款. Design grammar: ticket and boarding-pass motif, perforation dashes, stamped seals, serial numbers, tear-off end panel. CONTINUOUS STRUCTURE — this is the whole point of the plate: a continuous perforation dash line running horizontally through the strip with a repeating ticket-edge scallop along the bottom. Colourway cool-editorial: cool off-white, deep navy, soft slate blue accent. Surface soft-glaze: a soft glazed sheen with gentle highlight falloff and no harsh reflection. Every 1080 px along the strip is a cut line: keep the design either continuous across those cuts or clear of them, and never place a self-contained motif so that it straddles one. Leave broad calm areas with no detail — headlines, body copy and logos are typeset in Canva on top of this plate, and they need somewhere quiet to land.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
NO TEXT OF ANY KIND — no letters, words, numbers, page numbers, headlines, captions, labels, lorem ipsum, fake glyphs, handwriting or signage in any language. No logo, watermark, signature or AI-tool badge. No human figure, face, hand, animal or recognizable branded product. No card borders, frames, crop marks, seam guides, gutters, drop-shadowed panels or anything that reads as a divided grid of separate cards. No phone mockup, no presentation slide, no surrounding canvas. NO PHOTOGRAPHY ANYWHERE ON THE PLATE — no photographic landscape, interior, sky, foliage, texture photo or photo-realistic fill, not even faint, tinted, cropped inside a frame or used as a corner accent. Photo windows must be left EMPTY: draw the frame outline only and leave the inside as the plain paper ground. Photographs are placed in Canva afterwards at full resolution, because the plate is stretched to fit the strip afterwards and any photograph in it smears into pulp. No high-detail focal subject and no illustrated centrepiece — a plate is a stage, not a picture. No hard vignette, heavy noise, neon glow or blown-out highlight that would fight typography.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. This plate is a background only. Text is typeset on top of it later, so more than half of the surface must stay quiet enough to read 36 px body copy against.
2. Compose as one continuous strip. Any structural element — rule, band, path, torn edge, gradient — must run unbroken from the left edge to the right edge.
3. Self-contained motifs must not straddle a cut line. Either repeat them on a rhythm that clears the cuts, or let the design be genuinely continuous instead.
4. Keep contrast low and even along the whole strip: a plate that is dark at one end and pale at the other produces cards that no longer look like a set.
5. Hold one palette and one texture for the entire plate. Colour variation is delivered as a separate colourway plate, not as drift inside one plate.
6. Output the widest aspect ratio the tool offers at the highest available resolution; the strip is fitted and cut afterwards by scripts/split_carousel.py.
7. Detail level matters more than pixel count here: the plate is stretched several times its generated width, which soft texture survives and fine structure does not.
8. PRE-COMPRESS THE GEOMETRY. You can only output about 2.25:1 but the strip is 6.75:1, so everything you draw is stretched roughly 3× wider afterwards. Draw every arch, frame, circle or motif THREE TIMES NARROWER than it should finally look — a tall narrow arch here becomes a correctly-proportioned arch on the card. Horizontal rules and bands are unaffected.
9. ONE MOTIF PER CARD, evenly spaced. If the set is N cards, place exactly N repeats across the strip, each centred in its own 1/N slice, so no card inherits a motif that has drifted off-centre or been split between two cards.
10. No vertical dividing rules between the repeats. A vertical line at a cut turns the swipe into a row of bordered panels, which is the one thing the plate must never look like.

items.purpose: 8 張連續背景帶
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create ONE wide, seamless, TEXT-FREE background plate for an Instagram carousel. It will be machine-split into 8 separate 3:4 cards of 1080×1440 px, so compose it as one continuous horizontal strip that reads left to right (final strip size 8640×1440). Output the widest aspect ratio this tool supports — 16:9 is fine; the strip is fitted afterwards. TEMPLATE FAMILY botanical-letterpress+before-after｜植物凸版・前後對比款. Design grammar: letterpress impression on heavy stock, botanical line engravings, deep debossed rules, ivory paper, restrained ornament. CONTINUOUS STRUCTURE — this is the whole point of the plate: one continuous debossed baseline rule across the strip with sparse engraved botanical stems rising at irregular intervals. Colourway sea-glass: chalk white, deep teal, pale seafoam accent. Surface smooth-matte: a smooth matte finish with no visible texture and very clean edges. Every 1080 px along the strip is a cut line: keep the design either continuous across those cuts or clear of them, and never place a self-contained motif so that it straddles one. Leave broad calm areas with no detail — headlines, body copy and logos are typeset in Canva on top of this plate, and they need somewhere quiet to land.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
NO TEXT OF ANY KIND — no letters, words, numbers, page numbers, headlines, captions, labels, lorem ipsum, fake glyphs, handwriting or signage in any language. No logo, watermark, signature or AI-tool badge. No human figure, face, hand, animal or recognizable branded product. No card borders, frames, crop marks, seam guides, gutters, drop-shadowed panels or anything that reads as a divided grid of separate cards. No phone mockup, no presentation slide, no surrounding canvas. NO PHOTOGRAPHY ANYWHERE ON THE PLATE — no photographic landscape, interior, sky, foliage, texture photo or photo-realistic fill, not even faint, tinted, cropped inside a frame or used as a corner accent. Photo windows must be left EMPTY: draw the frame outline only and leave the inside as the plain paper ground. Photographs are placed in Canva afterwards at full resolution, because the plate is stretched to fit the strip afterwards and any photograph in it smears into pulp. No high-detail focal subject and no illustrated centrepiece — a plate is a stage, not a picture. No hard vignette, heavy noise, neon glow or blown-out highlight that would fight typography.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. This plate is a background only. Text is typeset on top of it later, so more than half of the surface must stay quiet enough to read 36 px body copy against.
2. Compose as one continuous strip. Any structural element — rule, band, path, torn edge, gradient — must run unbroken from the left edge to the right edge.
3. Self-contained motifs must not straddle a cut line. Either repeat them on a rhythm that clears the cuts, or let the design be genuinely continuous instead.
4. Keep contrast low and even along the whole strip: a plate that is dark at one end and pale at the other produces cards that no longer look like a set.
5. Hold one palette and one texture for the entire plate. Colour variation is delivered as a separate colourway plate, not as drift inside one plate.
6. Output the widest aspect ratio the tool offers at the highest available resolution; the strip is fitted and cut afterwards by scripts/split_carousel.py.
7. Detail level matters more than pixel count here: the plate is stretched several times its generated width, which soft texture survives and fine structure does not.
8. PRE-COMPRESS THE GEOMETRY. You can only output about 2.25:1 but the strip is 6.75:1, so everything you draw is stretched roughly 3× wider afterwards. Draw every arch, frame, circle or motif THREE TIMES NARROWER than it should finally look — a tall narrow arch here becomes a correctly-proportioned arch on the card. Horizontal rules and bands are unaffected.
9. ONE MOTIF PER CARD, evenly spaced. If the set is N cards, place exactly N repeats across the strip, each centred in its own 1/N slice, so no card inherits a motif that has drifted off-centre or been split between two cards.
10. No vertical dividing rules between the repeats. A vertical line at a cut turns the swipe into a row of bordered panels, which is the one thing the plate must never look like.

briefs.summary: 買家導向行業「婚禮策劃」。今天的組合是「誤解破除款」的故事節奏 × 「夜光卡」的視覺語法 × graphite-coral 配色 × editorial-mix 字型配對。一天一個產品：8 張母圖 → 分割 → Canva 上字。

items.purpose: 8 張連續背景帶
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create ONE wide, seamless, TEXT-FREE background plate for an Instagram carousel. It will be machine-split into 8 separate 3:4 cards of 1080×1440 px, so compose it as one continuous horizontal strip that reads left to right (final strip size 8640×1440). Output the widest aspect ratio this tool supports — 16:9 is fine; the strip is fitted afterwards. TEMPLATE FAMILY luminous-nightcard+myth-buster｜夜光卡・誤解破除款. Design grammar: deep tinted ground with one luminous accent line drawn from the palette, soft glow falloff, high-contrast type wells, minimal ornament. CONTINUOUS STRUCTURE — this is the whole point of the plate: a deep tinted field with a single luminous accent line travelling the entire length of the strip, glowing softly and never breaking. Colourway graphite-coral: light graphite grey, off-black, warm coral accent. Surface recycled-fleck: recycled stock with tiny darker flecks and slightly irregular edges. Every 1080 px along the strip is a cut line: keep the design either continuous across those cuts or clear of them, and never place a self-contained motif so that it straddles one. Leave broad calm areas with no detail — headlines, body copy and logos are typeset in Canva on top of this plate, and they need somewhere quiet to land.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
NO TEXT OF ANY KIND — no letters, words, numbers, page numbers, headlines, captions, labels, lorem ipsum, fake glyphs, handwriting or signage in any language. No logo, watermark, signature or AI-tool badge. No human figure, face, hand, animal or recognizable branded product. No card borders, frames, crop marks, seam guides, gutters, drop-shadowed panels or anything that reads as a divided grid of separate cards. No phone mockup, no presentation slide, no surrounding canvas. NO PHOTOGRAPHY ANYWHERE ON THE PLATE — no photographic landscape, interior, sky, foliage, texture photo or photo-realistic fill, not even faint, tinted, cropped inside a frame or used as a corner accent. Photo windows must be left EMPTY: draw the frame outline only and leave the inside as the plain paper ground. Photographs are placed in Canva afterwards at full resolution, because the plate is stretched to fit the strip afterwards and any photograph in it smears into pulp. No high-detail focal subject and no illustrated centrepiece — a plate is a stage, not a picture. No hard vignette, heavy noise, neon glow or blown-out highlight that would fight typography.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. This plate is a background only. Text is typeset on top of it later, so more than half of the surface must stay quiet enough to read 36 px body copy against.
2. Compose as one continuous strip. Any structural element — rule, band, path, torn edge, gradient — must run unbroken from the left edge to the right edge.
3. Self-contained motifs must not straddle a cut line. Either repeat them on a rhythm that clears the cuts, or let the design be genuinely continuous instead.
4. Keep contrast low and even along the whole strip: a plate that is dark at one end and pale at the other produces cards that no longer look like a set.
5. Hold one palette and one texture for the entire plate. Colour variation is delivered as a separate colourway plate, not as drift inside one plate.
6. Output the widest aspect ratio the tool offers at the highest available resolution; the strip is fitted and cut afterwards by scripts/split_carousel.py.
7. Detail level matters more than pixel count here: the plate is stretched several times its generated width, which soft texture survives and fine structure does not.
8. PRE-COMPRESS THE GEOMETRY. You can only output about 2.25:1 but the strip is 6.75:1, so everything you draw is stretched roughly 3× wider afterwards. Draw every arch, frame, circle or motif THREE TIMES NARROWER than it should finally look — a tall narrow arch here becomes a correctly-proportioned arch on the card. Horizontal rules and bands are unaffected.
9. ONE MOTIF PER CARD, evenly spaced. If the set is N cards, place exactly N repeats across the strip, each centred in its own 1/N slice, so no card inherits a motif that has drifted off-centre or been split between two cards.
10. No vertical dividing rules between the repeats. A vertical line at a cut turns the swipe into a row of bordered panels, which is the one thing the plate must never look like.

briefs.title: IG 行業包｜美業個人工作室｜列表款×靜謐拱窗編輯誌
briefs.meta: 第 2 輪・7/9 家｜9 張 3:4｜warm-neutral · rounded-warm · uncoated-paper
briefs.summary: 買家導向行業「美業個人工作室」。今天的組合是「列表款」的故事節奏 × 「靜謐拱窗編輯誌」的視覺語法 × warm-neutral 配色 × rounded-warm 字型配對。一天一個產品：9 張母圖 → 分割 → Canva 上字。

items.purpose: 9 張連續背景帶
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create ONE wide, seamless, TEXT-FREE background plate for an Instagram carousel. It will be machine-split into 9 separate 3:4 cards of 1080×1440 px, so compose it as one continuous horizontal strip that reads left to right (final strip size 9720×1440). Output the widest aspect ratio this tool supports — 16:9 is fine; the strip is fitted afterwards. TEMPLATE FAMILY quiet-arch-editorial+list-stack｜靜謐拱窗編輯誌・列表款. Design grammar: asymmetrical literary editorial pages, one tall arched photo window, generous cream negative space, fine serif rules and tiny botanical marks. CONTINUOUS STRUCTURE — this is the whole point of the plate: one continuous cream field with a repeating tall arch outline motif and a single fine vertical rule travelling the whole strip. Colourway warm-neutral: warm cream paper, espresso brown, muted sage accent. Surface uncoated-paper: matte uncoated paper grain with a barely-visible film grain. Every 1080 px along the strip is a cut line: keep the design either continuous across those cuts or clear of them, and never place a self-contained motif so that it straddles one. Leave broad calm areas with no detail — headlines, body copy and logos are typeset in Canva on top of this plate, and they need somewhere quiet to land.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
NO TEXT OF ANY KIND — no letters, words, numbers, page numbers, headlines, captions, labels, lorem ipsum, fake glyphs, handwriting or signage in any language. No logo, watermark, signature or AI-tool badge. No human figure, face, hand, animal or recognizable branded product. No card borders, frames, crop marks, seam guides, gutters, drop-shadowed panels or anything that reads as a divided grid of separate cards. No phone mockup, no presentation slide, no surrounding canvas. NO PHOTOGRAPHY ANYWHERE ON THE PLATE — no photographic landscape, interior, sky, foliage, texture photo or photo-realistic fill, not even faint, tinted, cropped inside a frame or used as a corner accent. Photo windows must be left EMPTY: draw the frame outline only and leave the inside as the plain paper ground. Photographs are placed in Canva afterwards at full resolution, because the plate is stretched to fit the strip afterwards and any photograph in it smears into pulp. No high-detail focal subject and no illustrated centrepiece — a plate is a stage, not a picture. No hard vignette, heavy noise, neon glow or blown-out highlight that would fight typography.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. This plate is a background only. Text is typeset on top of it later, so more than half of the surface must stay quiet enough to read 36 px body copy against.
2. Compose as one continuous strip. Any structural element — rule, band, path, torn edge, gradient — must run unbroken from the left edge to the right edge.
3. Self-contained motifs must not straddle a cut line. Either repeat them on a rhythm that clears the cuts, or let the design be genuinely continuous instead.
4. Keep contrast low and even along the whole strip: a plate that is dark at one end and pale at the other produces cards that no longer look like a set.
5. Hold one palette and one texture for the entire plate. Colour variation is delivered as a separate colourway plate, not as drift inside one plate.
6. Output the widest aspect ratio the tool offers at the highest available resolution; the strip is fitted and cut afterwards by scripts/split_carousel.py.
7. Detail level matters more than pixel count here: the plate is stretched several times its generated width, which soft texture survives and fine structure does not.
8. PRE-COMPRESS THE GEOMETRY. You can only output about 2.25:1 but the strip is 6.75:1, so everything you draw is stretched roughly 3× wider afterwards. Draw every arch, frame, circle or motif THREE TIMES NARROWER than it should finally look — a tall narrow arch here becomes a correctly-proportioned arch on the card. Horizontal rules and bands are unaffected.
9. ONE MOTIF PER CARD, evenly spaced. If the set is N cards, place exactly N repeats across the strip, each centred in its own 1/N slice, so no card inherits a motif that has drifted off-centre or been split between two cards.
10. No vertical dividing rules between the repeats. A vertical line at a cut turns the swipe into a row of bordered panels, which is the one thing the plate must never look like.

items.purpose: 母圖 → 9 張卡片
items.text:
python3 scripts/split_carousel.py quiet-arch-editorial_list-stack_warm-neutral.png --cards 9
→ 輸出 9 張 1080×1440 卡片 + `_seam_preview.png`。
先看 seam preview：紅帶是每個切點左右各 80px 的禁區，有裝飾或主體被切開就回頭改母圖，不要硬上。
母圖是抽象紋理才用預設 `--fit stretch`；若母圖有拱門、照片框、物件等可辨識結構，改用 `--fit cover`（保幾何但裁掉大部分高度）。

briefs.meta: 第 2 輪・8/9 家｜6 張 3:4｜ink-and-butter · mono-accent · laid-textile
briefs.summary: 買家導向行業「寵物服務」。今天的組合是「金句款」的故事節奏 × 「模組方格」的視覺語法 × ink-and-butter 配色 × mono-accent 字型配對。一天一個產品：6 張母圖 → 分割 → Canva 上字。

items.purpose: 6 張連續背景帶
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create ONE wide, seamless, TEXT-FREE background plate for an Instagram carousel. It will be machine-split into 6 separate 3:4 cards of 1080×1440 px, so compose it as one continuous horizontal strip that reads left to right (final strip size 6480×1440). Output the widest aspect ratio this tool supports — 16:9 is fine; the strip is fitted afterwards. TEMPLATE FAMILY menu-modular-grid+quote-anchor｜模組方格・金句款. Design grammar: bold modular menu grid, espresso color blocks, product cut-outs, price-tag-like labels and crisp sans-serif hierarchy. CONTINUOUS STRUCTURE — this is the whole point of the plate: an unbroken run of modular colour blocks in two alternating tones, with a thin label rail crossing the entire strip. Colourway ink-and-butter: soft butter yellow, near-black ink, warm grey accent. Surface laid-textile: a fine woven textile weave under softly diffused light. Every 1080 px along the strip is a cut line: keep the design either continuous across those cuts or clear of them, and never place a self-contained motif so that it straddles one. Leave broad calm areas with no detail — headlines, body copy and logos are typeset in Canva on top of this plate, and they need somewhere quiet to land.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
NO TEXT OF ANY KIND — no letters, words, numbers, page numbers, headlines, captions, labels, lorem ipsum, fake glyphs, handwriting or signage in any language. No logo, watermark, signature or AI-tool badge. No human figure, face, hand, animal or recognizable branded product. No card borders, frames, crop marks, seam guides, gutters, drop-shadowed panels or anything that reads as a divided grid of separate cards. No phone mockup, no presentation slide, no surrounding canvas. NO PHOTOGRAPHY ANYWHERE ON THE PLATE — no photographic landscape, interior, sky, foliage, texture photo or photo-realistic fill, not even faint, tinted, cropped inside a frame or used as a corner accent. Photo windows must be left EMPTY: draw the frame outline only and leave the inside as the plain paper ground. Photographs are placed in Canva afterwards at full resolution, because the plate is stretched to fit the strip afterwards and any photograph in it smears into pulp. No high-detail focal subject and no illustrated centrepiece — a plate is a stage, not a picture. No hard vignette, heavy noise, neon glow or blown-out highlight that would fight typography.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. This plate is a background only. Text is typeset on top of it later, so more than half of the surface must stay quiet enough to read 36 px body copy against.
2. Compose as one continuous strip. Any structural element — rule, band, path, torn edge, gradient — must run unbroken from the left edge to the right edge.
3. Self-contained motifs must not straddle a cut line. Either repeat them on a rhythm that clears the cuts, or let the design be genuinely continuous instead.
4. Keep contrast low and even along the whole strip: a plate that is dark at one end and pale at the other produces cards that no longer look like a set.
5. Hold one palette and one texture for the entire plate. Colour variation is delivered as a separate colourway plate, not as drift inside one plate.
6. Output the widest aspect ratio the tool offers at the highest available resolution; the strip is fitted and cut afterwards by scripts/split_carousel.py.
7. Detail level matters more than pixel count here: the plate is stretched several times its generated width, which soft texture survives and fine structure does not.
8. PRE-COMPRESS THE GEOMETRY. You can only output about 2.25:1 but the strip is 6.75:1, so everything you draw is stretched roughly 3× wider afterwards. Draw every arch, frame, circle or motif THREE TIMES NARROWER than it should finally look — a tall narrow arch here becomes a correctly-proportioned arch on the card. Horizontal rules and bands are unaffected.
9. ONE MOTIF PER CARD, evenly spaced. If the set is N cards, place exactly N repeats across the strip, each centred in its own 1/N slice, so no card inherits a motif that has drifted off-centre or been split between two cards.
10. No vertical dividing rules between the repeats. A vertical line at a cut turns the swipe into a row of bordered panels, which is the one thing the plate must never look like.

items.text: CANVA TEMPLATE SPEC｜模組方格・金句款（menu-modular-grid+quote-anchor）｜寵物服務｜招牌服務｜引言 + 大字，最好做、存檔率高. 1080×1440 px、6 個獨立頁面。設計語法：bold modular menu grid, espresso color blocks, product cut-outs, price-tag-like labels and crisp sans-serif hierarchy。字型配對 mono-accent：a clean sans for headlines with a monospace face for labels, numbers and captions。安全邊 80px，切點禁區左右各 80px。把分割出來的卡片當背景，文字全部用可編輯 Canva 文字重打，不要留任何燒進圖裡的字。圖層命名要讓買家看得懂：BACKGROUND / HEADLINE / BODY / LABEL / PHOTO FRAME / PAGE / LOGO / CTA。最多兩個字型家族、三個品牌色。⚠️ 字型只能用可外發的授權（Canva Pro 專屬字型不能用在要交付的模板）。⚠️ 說明書要寫兩句：上傳時把比例從預設 4:5 改成 3:4；要縮成 6–8 張時，優先刪「視覺停頓」與最後一個並列項，永遠保留封面與 CTA。存成 master design，每次客製前先複製，最後產出 Brand Template 連結交付。

items.purpose: 9 張連續背景帶
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create ONE wide, seamless, TEXT-FREE background plate for an Instagram carousel. It will be machine-split into 9 separate 3:4 cards of 1080×1440 px, so compose it as one continuous horizontal strip that reads left to right (final strip size 9720×1440). Output the widest aspect ratio this tool supports — 16:9 is fine; the strip is fitted afterwards. TEMPLATE FAMILY field-notes+case-teardown｜田野筆記・案例拆解款. Design grammar: field-notebook education pages, ruled-paper cues, annotated diagrams, underlines, numbered callouts and restrained handwritten accents. CONTINUOUS STRUCTURE — this is the whole point of the plate: continuous ruled-paper lines across the whole strip with a faint margin rule and occasional hand-drawn arrow marks. Colourway forest-linen: natural linen, deep forest green, pale gold accent. Surface soft-glaze: a soft glazed sheen with gentle highlight falloff and no harsh reflection. Every 1080 px along the strip is a cut line: keep the design either continuous across those cuts or clear of them, and never place a self-contained motif so that it straddles one. Leave broad calm areas with no detail — headlines, body copy and logos are typeset in Canva on top of this plate, and they need somewhere quiet to land.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
NO TEXT OF ANY KIND — no letters, words, numbers, page numbers, headlines, captions, labels, lorem ipsum, fake glyphs, handwriting or signage in any language. No logo, watermark, signature or AI-tool badge. No human figure, face, hand, animal or recognizable branded product. No card borders, frames, crop marks, seam guides, gutters, drop-shadowed panels or anything that reads as a divided grid of separate cards. No phone mockup, no presentation slide, no surrounding canvas. NO PHOTOGRAPHY ANYWHERE ON THE PLATE — no photographic landscape, interior, sky, foliage, texture photo or photo-realistic fill, not even faint, tinted, cropped inside a frame or used as a corner accent. Photo windows must be left EMPTY: draw the frame outline only and leave the inside as the plain paper ground. Photographs are placed in Canva afterwards at full resolution, because the plate is stretched to fit the strip afterwards and any photograph in it smears into pulp. No high-detail focal subject and no illustrated centrepiece — a plate is a stage, not a picture. No hard vignette, heavy noise, neon glow or blown-out highlight that would fight typography.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. This plate is a background only. Text is typeset on top of it later, so more than half of the surface must stay quiet enough to read 36 px body copy against.
2. Compose as one continuous strip. Any structural element — rule, band, path, torn edge, gradient — must run unbroken from the left edge to the right edge.
3. Self-contained motifs must not straddle a cut line. Either repeat them on a rhythm that clears the cuts, or let the design be genuinely continuous instead.
4. Keep contrast low and even along the whole strip: a plate that is dark at one end and pale at the other produces cards that no longer look like a set.
5. Hold one palette and one texture for the entire plate. Colour variation is delivered as a separate colourway plate, not as drift inside one plate.
6. Output the widest aspect ratio the tool offers at the highest available resolution; the strip is fitted and cut afterwards by scripts/split_carousel.py.
7. Detail level matters more than pixel count here: the plate is stretched several times its generated width, which soft texture survives and fine structure does not.
8. PRE-COMPRESS THE GEOMETRY. You can only output about 2.25:1 but the strip is 6.75:1, so everything you draw is stretched roughly 3× wider afterwards. Draw every arch, frame, circle or motif THREE TIMES NARROWER than it should finally look — a tall narrow arch here becomes a correctly-proportioned arch on the card. Horizontal rules and bands are unaffected.
9. ONE MOTIF PER CARD, evenly spaced. If the set is N cards, place exactly N repeats across the strip, each centred in its own 1/N slice, so no card inherits a motif that has drifted off-centre or been split between two cards.
10. No vertical dividing rules between the repeats. A vertical line at a cut turns the swipe into a row of bordered panels, which is the one thing the plate must never look like.

items.purpose: 母圖 → 9 張卡片

python3 scripts/split_carousel.py field-notes_case-teardown_forest-linen.png --cards 9

items.text: CANVA TEMPLATE SPEC｜田野筆記・案例拆解款（field-notes+case-teardown）｜獨立咖啡店｜招牌服務｜一個真實案例，從起點拆到結果. 1080×1440 px、9 個獨立頁面。設計語法：field-notebook education pages, ruled-paper cues, annotated diagrams, underlines, numbered callouts and restrained handwritten accents。字型配對 condensed-impact：a tall condensed sans for headlines with a wide-set body face。安全邊 80px，切點禁區左右各 80px。把分割出來的卡片當背景，文字全部用可編輯 Canva 文字重打，不要留任何燒進圖裡的字。圖層命名要讓買家看得懂：BACKGROUND / HEADLINE / BODY / LABEL / PHOTO FRAME / PAGE / LOGO / CTA。最多兩個字型家族、三個品牌色。⚠️ 字型只能用可外發的授權（Canva Pro 專屬字型不能用在要交付的模板）。⚠️ 說明書要寫兩句：上傳時把比例從預設 4:5 改成 3:4；要縮成 6–8 張時，優先刪「視覺停頓」與最後一個並列項，永遠保留封面與 CTA。存成 master design，每次客製前先複製，最後產出 Brand Template 連結交付。

items.purpose: 9 張連續背景帶
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create ONE wide, seamless, TEXT-FREE background plate for an Instagram carousel. It will be machine-split into 9 separate 3:4 cards of 1080×1440 px, so compose it as one continuous horizontal strip that reads left to right (final strip size 9720×1440). Output the widest aspect ratio this tool supports — 16:9 is fine; the strip is fitted afterwards. TEMPLATE FAMILY list-stack｜列表款. Design grammar: numbered stack layout, oversized numerals as the dominant graphic, one rule line per item, generous left margin. CONTINUOUS STRUCTURE — this is the whole point of the plate: a continuous vertical rule running the full height near the left third, crossed by evenly spaced horizontal hairlines, with a wide calm field to the right for numbering and text. Colourway sand-cobalt: warm sand, strong cobalt blue, chalk white accent. Surface smooth-matte: a smooth matte finish with no visible texture and very clean edges. Every 1080 px along the strip is a cut line: keep the design either continuous across those cuts or clear of them, and never place a self-contained motif so that it straddles one. Leave broad calm areas with no detail — headlines, body copy and logos are typeset in Canva on top of this plate, and they need somewhere quiet to land.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
NO TEXT OF ANY KIND — no letters, words, numbers, page numbers, headlines, captions, labels, lorem ipsum, fake glyphs, handwriting or signage in any language. No logo, watermark, signature or AI-tool badge. No human figure, face, hand, animal or recognizable branded product. No card borders, frames, crop marks, seam guides, gutters, drop-shadowed panels or anything that reads as a divided grid of separate cards. No phone mockup, no presentation slide, no surrounding canvas. NO PHOTOGRAPHY ANYWHERE ON THE PLATE — no photographic landscape, interior, sky, foliage, texture photo or photo-realistic fill, not even faint, tinted, cropped inside a frame or used as a corner accent. Photo windows must be left EMPTY: draw the frame outline only and leave the inside as the plain paper ground. Photographs are placed in Canva afterwards at full resolution, because the plate is stretched to fit the strip afterwards and any photograph in it smears into pulp. No high-detail focal subject and no illustrated centrepiece — a plate is a stage, not a picture. No hard vignette, heavy noise, neon glow or blown-out highlight that would fight typography.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. This plate is a background only. Text is typeset on top of it later, so more than half of the surface must stay quiet enough to read 36 px body copy against.
2. Compose as one continuous strip. Any structural element — rule, band, path, torn edge, gradient — must run unbroken from the left edge to the right edge.
3. Self-contained motifs must not straddle a cut line. Either repeat them on a rhythm that clears the cuts, or let the design be genuinely continuous instead.
4. Keep contrast low and even along the whole strip: a plate that is dark at one end and pale at the other produces cards that no longer look like a set.
5. Hold one palette and one texture for the entire plate. Colour variation is delivered as a separate colourway plate, not as drift inside one plate.
6. Output the widest aspect ratio the tool offers at the highest available resolution; the strip is fitted and cut afterwards by scripts/split_carousel.py.
7. Detail level matters more than pixel count here: the plate is stretched several times its generated width, which soft texture survives and fine structure does not.

items.purpose: 列表款
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Typeset card 1/9 of one Instagram carousel set, 3:4 at 1080×1440 px, edge to edge. Output ONE standalone card. Context: 百搭 Kit｜列表款（N 個重點／N 個常見錯誤）. TEMPLATE FAMILY list-stack｜列表款; design grammar: numbered stack layout, oversized numerals as the dominant graphic, one rule line per item, generous left margin; colourway sand-cobalt: warm sand, strong cobalt blue, chalk white accent; type pairing grotesk-led: a bold neo-grotesk for headlines with a lighter weight of the same family for body. This card's storytelling role is 「封面」 and nothing else. Copy to set (Traditional Chinese, Taiwan usage):
大數字 + 一句 hook
Show only the copy roles this role needs. This is the cover: it must survive as a 160 px thumbnail, so one dominant line, and the logo may appear here. Reserve 80 px of quiet space on the left and right edges: this card sits next to its siblings in a swipe, and anything touching the edge reads as sliced.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
No garbled, invented, mirrored or partially-rendered Chinese glyphs; no lorem ipsum, no placeholder squiggle standing in for text, no English filler where Traditional Chinese is specified. No watermark, signature, stock-photo mark, AI-tool badge or imitation of an existing brand, designer or publication. No nine-cards-on-one-canvas, no phone or device mockup, no drop-shadowed card floating on a coloured backdrop, no surrounding white canvas, no crop marks or safe-area guides. No text, logo or key subject inside the outer safe margin or crossing a slice seam. No heavy drop shadow, bevel, glossy gradient, neon glow, 3D extruded type or 2015-era template look. No more than two type families or three brand colours. No emoji, no unlicensed icon set, no chart with invented numbers presented as real data.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. Output ONE standalone card at the stated pixel size, edge to edge, with nothing outside the artboard.
2. Keep an 80 px safe margin on all four sides; the Instagram grid thumbnail crops a 4:5 card on both sides, so anything load-bearing sits centred and inside that margin.
3. The cover must be readable as a 160 px thumbnail: the hook needs one dominant line at 90 px or larger and a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against whatever is behind it.
4. Render only the copy roles this card is assigned. A card that does not need a logo, CTA or hashtag must not show one.
5. Use real, legible Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage) with punctuation, and keep body text at 36 px or larger — a phone reader is holding this at arm's length.
6. Every component must stay visually separable for rebuilding in Canva: text block, photo or diagram frame, decorative element, page number. Do not print layer-instruction labels on the card.
7. Hold the set's brand grammar — palette, type pairing, margin, decorative device — while changing composition and information density from card to card.
8. Body copy must be replaceable: no text baked into a photograph, no headline whose meaning depends on a decorative shape that cannot be moved.

items.purpose: 8 張連續背景帶
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create ONE wide, seamless, TEXT-FREE background plate for an Instagram carousel. It will be machine-split into 8 separate 3:4 cards of 1080×1440 px, so compose it as one continuous horizontal strip that reads left to right (final strip size 8640×1440). Output the widest aspect ratio this tool supports — 16:9 is fine; the strip is fitted afterwards. TEMPLATE FAMILY before-after｜前後對比款. Design grammar: split-field comparison, a hard vertical or diagonal divider, one muted side and one saturated side, matching label chips. CONTINUOUS STRUCTURE — this is the whole point of the plate: a single continuous diagonal division sweeping across the whole strip, muted tone above and saturated tone below, so each card inherits a different part of the same diagonal. Colourway soft-clay: pale oat, terracotta clay, dusty rose accent. Surface recycled-fleck: recycled stock with tiny darker flecks and slightly irregular edges. Every 1080 px along the strip is a cut line: keep the design either continuous across those cuts or clear of them, and never place a self-contained motif so that it straddles one. Leave broad calm areas with no detail — headlines, body copy and logos are typeset in Canva on top of this plate, and they need somewhere quiet to land.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
NO TEXT OF ANY KIND — no letters, words, numbers, page numbers, headlines, captions, labels, lorem ipsum, fake glyphs, handwriting or signage in any language. No logo, watermark, signature or AI-tool badge. No human figure, face, hand, animal or recognizable branded product. No card borders, frames, crop marks, seam guides, gutters, drop-shadowed panels or anything that reads as a divided grid of separate cards. No phone mockup, no presentation slide, no surrounding canvas. NO PHOTOGRAPHY ANYWHERE ON THE PLATE — no photographic landscape, interior, sky, foliage, texture photo or photo-realistic fill, not even faint, tinted, cropped inside a frame or used as a corner accent. Photo windows must be left EMPTY: draw the frame outline only and leave the inside as the plain paper ground. Photographs are placed in Canva afterwards at full resolution, because the plate is stretched to fit the strip afterwards and any photograph in it smears into pulp. No high-detail focal subject and no illustrated centrepiece — a plate is a stage, not a picture. No hard vignette, heavy noise, neon glow or blown-out highlight that would fight typography.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. This plate is a background only. Text is typeset on top of it later, so more than half of the surface must stay quiet enough to read 36 px body copy against.
2. Compose as one continuous strip. Any structural element — rule, band, path, torn edge, gradient — must run unbroken from the left edge to the right edge.
3. Self-contained motifs must not straddle a cut line. Either repeat them on a rhythm that clears the cuts, or let the design be genuinely continuous instead.
4. Keep contrast low and even along the whole strip: a plate that is dark at one end and pale at the other produces cards that no longer look like a set.
5. Hold one palette and one texture for the entire plate. Colour variation is delivered as a separate colourway plate, not as drift inside one plate.
6. Output the widest aspect ratio the tool offers at the highest available resolution; the strip is fitted and cut afterwards by scripts/split_carousel.py.
7. Detail level matters more than pixel count here: the plate is stretched several times its generated width, which soft texture survives and fine structure does not.
8. PRE-COMPRESS THE GEOMETRY. You can only output about 2.25:1 but the strip is 6.75:1, so everything you draw is stretched roughly 3× wider afterwards. Draw every arch, frame, circle or motif THREE TIMES NARROWER than it should finally look — a tall narrow arch here becomes a correctly-proportioned arch on the card. Horizontal rules and bands are unaffected.
9. ONE MOTIF PER CARD, evenly spaced. If the set is N cards, place exactly N repeats across the strip, each centred in its own 1/N slice, so no card inherits a motif that has drifted off-centre or been split between two cards.
10. No vertical dividing rules between the repeats. A vertical line at a cut turns the swipe into a row of bordered panels, which is the one thing the plate must never look like.

Typeset card 3/8 of one Instagram carousel set, 3:4 at 1080×1440 px, edge to edge. Output ONE standalone card. Context: 百搭 Kit｜前後對比款（before/after、錯 vs 對）. This card's storytelling role is 「問題」 and nothing else. Copy to set (Traditional Chinese, Taiwan usage):
這樣做會付出什麼代價
Show only the copy roles this role needs. Logo, CTA and hashtags belong on the cover and the final card — do not repeat them here. Reserve 80 px of quiet space on the left and right edges: this card sits next to its siblings in a swipe, and anything touching the edge reads as sliced.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
No garbled, invented, mirrored or partially-rendered Chinese glyphs; no lorem ipsum, no placeholder squiggle standing in for text, no English filler where Traditional Chinese is specified. No watermark, signature, stock-photo mark, AI-tool badge or imitation of an existing brand, designer or publication. No nine-cards-on-one-canvas, no phone or device mockup, no drop-shadowed card floating on a coloured backdrop, no surrounding white canvas, no crop marks or safe-area guides. No text, logo or key subject inside the outer safe margin or crossing a slice seam. No heavy drop shadow, bevel, glossy gradient, neon glow, 3D extruded type or 2015-era template look. No more than two type families or three brand colours. No emoji, no unlicensed icon set, no chart with invented numbers presented as real data.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. Output ONE standalone card at the stated pixel size, edge to edge, with nothing outside the artboard.
2. Keep an 80 px safe margin on all four sides; the Instagram grid thumbnail crops a 4:5 card on both sides, so anything load-bearing sits centred and inside that margin.
3. The cover must be readable as a 160 px thumbnail: the hook needs one dominant line at 90 px or larger and a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against whatever is behind it.
4. Render only the copy roles this card is assigned. A card that does not need a logo, CTA or hashtag must not show one.
5. Use real, legible Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage) with punctuation, and keep body text at 36 px or larger — a phone reader is holding this at arm's length.
6. Every component must stay visually separable for rebuilding in Canva: text block, photo or diagram frame, decorative element, page number. Do not print layer-instruction labels on the card.
7. Hold the set's brand grammar — palette, type pairing, margin, decorative device — while changing composition and information density from card to card.
8. Body copy must be replaceable: no text baked into a photograph, no headline whose meaning depends on a decorative shape that cannot be moved.

items.purpose: 可販售模板｜前後對比款
items.text: CANVA TEMPLATE SPEC｜前後對比款（before-after）｜百搭 Kit｜前後對比款（before/after、錯 vs 對）. 1080×1440 px、8 個獨立頁面。設計語法：split-field comparison, a hard vertical or diagonal divider, one muted side and one saturated side, matching label chips。字型配對 serif-led：a high-contrast Traditional-Chinese serif for headlines with a quiet grotesk for body。安全邊 80px，切點禁區左右各 80px。把分割出來的卡片當背景，文字全部用可編輯 Canva 文字重打，不要留任何燒進圖裡的字。圖層命名要讓買家看得懂：BACKGROUND / HEADLINE / BODY / LABEL / PHOTO FRAME / PAGE / LOGO / CTA。最多兩個字型家族、三個品牌色。⚠️ 字型只能用可外發的授權（Canva Pro 專屬字型不能用在要交付的模板）。⚠️ 說明書要寫兩句：上傳時把比例從預設 4:5 改成 3:4；要縮成 6–8 張時，優先刪「視覺停頓」與最後一個並列項，永遠保留封面與 CTA。存成 master design，每次客製前先複製，最後產出 Brand Template 連結交付。

briefs.summary: 「教學步驟款」是結構型模板，任何行業都能套。今天產出 3 張無文字母圖（一色一張）、切成 9 張 1080×1440，再到 Canva 上字。五款做完就是一個可上架的 Kit，不必等行業研究。

items.purpose: 9 張連續背景帶
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create ONE wide, seamless, TEXT-FREE background plate for an Instagram carousel. It will be machine-split into 9 separate 3:4 cards of 1080×1440 px, so compose it as one continuous horizontal strip that reads left to right (final strip size 9720×1440). Output the widest aspect ratio this tool supports — 16:9 is fine; the strip is fitted afterwards. TEMPLATE FAMILY step-path｜教學步驟款. Design grammar: progress-path layout, a connecting line threading step markers, one step per card, small progress indicator in a fixed corner. CONTINUOUS STRUCTURE — this is the whole point of the plate: one unbroken connecting path line travelling horizontally across the entire strip with evenly spaced node dots, so the path visibly continues from card to card when swiped. Colourway plum-paper: warm grey paper, deep plum, muted apricot accent. Surface uncoated-paper: matte uncoated paper grain with a barely-visible film grain. Every 1080 px along the strip is a cut line: keep the design either continuous across those cuts or clear of them, and never place a self-contained motif so that it straddles one. Leave broad calm areas with no detail — headlines, body copy and logos are typeset in Canva on top of this plate, and they need somewhere quiet to land.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
NO TEXT OF ANY KIND — no letters, words, numbers, page numbers, headlines, captions, labels, lorem ipsum, fake glyphs, handwriting or signage in any language. No logo, watermark, signature or AI-tool badge. No human figure, face, hand, animal or recognizable branded product. No card borders, frames, crop marks, seam guides, gutters, drop-shadowed panels or anything that reads as a divided grid of separate cards. No phone mockup, no presentation slide, no surrounding canvas. NO PHOTOGRAPHY ANYWHERE ON THE PLATE — no photographic landscape, interior, sky, foliage, texture photo or photo-realistic fill, not even faint, tinted, cropped inside a frame or used as a corner accent. Photo windows must be left EMPTY: draw the frame outline only and leave the inside as the plain paper ground. Photographs are placed in Canva afterwards at full resolution, because the plate is stretched to fit the strip afterwards and any photograph in it smears into pulp. No high-detail focal subject and no illustrated centrepiece — a plate is a stage, not a picture. No hard vignette, heavy noise, neon glow or blown-out highlight that would fight typography.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. This plate is a background only. Text is typeset on top of it later, so more than half of the surface must stay quiet enough to read 36 px body copy against.
2. Compose as one continuous strip. Any structural element — rule, band, path, torn edge, gradient — must run unbroken from the left edge to the right edge.
3. Self-contained motifs must not straddle a cut line. Either repeat them on a rhythm that clears the cuts, or let the design be genuinely continuous instead.
4. Keep contrast low and even along the whole strip: a plate that is dark at one end and pale at the other produces cards that no longer look like a set.
5. Hold one palette and one texture for the entire plate. Colour variation is delivered as a separate colourway plate, not as drift inside one plate.
6. Output the widest aspect ratio the tool offers at the highest available resolution; the strip is fitted and cut afterwards by scripts/split_carousel.py.
7. Detail level matters more than pixel count here: the plate is stretched several times its generated width, which soft texture survives and fine structure does not.
8. PRE-COMPRESS THE GEOMETRY. You can only output about 2.25:1 but the strip is 6.75:1, so everything you draw is stretched roughly 3× wider afterwards. Draw every arch, frame, circle or motif THREE TIMES NARROWER than it should finally look — a tall narrow arch here becomes a correctly-proportioned arch on the card. Horizontal rules and bands are unaffected.
9. ONE MOTIF PER CARD, evenly spaced. If the set is N cards, place exactly N repeats across the strip, each centred in its own 1/N slice, so no card inherits a motif that has drifted off-centre or been split between two cards.
10. No vertical dividing rules between the repeats. A vertical line at a cut turns the swipe into a row of bordered panels, which is the one thing the plate must never look like.

CONTINUOUS STRUCTURE — this is the whole point of the plate: one unbroken connecting path line travelling horizontally across the entire strip with evenly spaced node dots, so the path visibly continues from card to card when swiped. Colourway cool-editorial: cool off-white, deep navy, soft slate blue accent. Surface uncoated-paper: matte uncoated paper grain with a barely-visible film grain. Every 1080 px along the strip is a cut line: keep the design either continuous across those cuts or clear of them, and never place a self-contained motif so that it straddles one. Leave broad calm areas with no detail — headlines, body copy and logos are typeset in Canva on top of this plate, and they need somewhere quiet to land.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
NO TEXT OF ANY KIND — no letters, words, numbers, page numbers, headlines, captions, labels, lorem ipsum, fake glyphs, handwriting or signage in any language. No logo, watermark, signature or AI-tool badge. No human figure, face, hand, animal or recognizable branded product. No card borders, frames, crop marks, seam guides, gutters, drop-shadowed panels or anything that reads as a divided grid of separate cards. No phone mockup, no presentation slide, no surrounding canvas. NO PHOTOGRAPHY ANYWHERE ON THE PLATE — no photographic landscape, interior, sky, foliage, texture photo or photo-realistic fill, not even faint, tinted, cropped inside a frame or used as a corner accent. Photo windows must be left EMPTY: draw the frame outline only and leave the inside as the plain paper ground. Photographs are placed in Canva afterwards at full resolution, because the plate is stretched to fit the strip afterwards and any photograph in it smears into pulp. No high-detail focal subject and no illustrated centrepiece — a plate is a stage, not a picture. No hard vignette, heavy noise, neon glow or blown-out highlight that would fight typography.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. This plate is a background only. Text is typeset on top of it later, so more than half of the surface must stay quiet enough to read 36 px body copy against.
2. Compose as one continuous strip. Any structural element — rule, band, path, torn edge, gradient — must run unbroken from the left edge to the right edge.
3. Self-contained motifs must not straddle a cut line. Either repeat them on a rhythm that clears the cuts, or let the design be genuinely continuous instead.
4. Keep contrast low and even along the whole strip: a plate that is dark at one end and pale at the other produces cards that no longer look like a set.
5. Hold one palette and one texture for the entire plate. Colour variation is delivered as a separate colourway plate, not as drift inside one plate.
6. Output the widest aspect ratio the tool offers at the highest available resolution; the strip is fitted and cut afterwards by scripts/split_carousel.py.
7. Detail level matters more than pixel count here: the plate is stretched several times its generated width, which soft texture survives and fine structure does not.
8. PRE-COMPRESS THE GEOMETRY. You can only output about 2.25:1 but the strip is 6.75:1, so everything you draw is stretched roughly 3× wider afterwards. Draw every arch, frame, circle or motif THREE TIMES NARROWER than it should finally look — a tall narrow arch here becomes a correctly-proportioned arch on the card. Horizontal rules and bands are unaffected.
9. ONE MOTIF PER CARD, evenly spaced. If the set is N cards, place exactly N repeats across the strip, each centred in its own 1/N slice, so no card inherits a motif that has drifted off-centre or been split between two cards.
10. No vertical dividing rules between the repeats. A vertical line at a cut turns the swipe into a row of bordered panels, which is the one thing the plate must never look like.

items.purpose: 母圖 → 9 張卡片
items.text:
python3 scripts/split_carousel.py step-path_plum-paper.png --cards 9
→ 輸出 9 張 1080×1440 卡片 + `_seam_preview.png`。

items.purpose: 6 張連續背景帶
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create ONE wide, seamless, TEXT-FREE background plate for an Instagram carousel. It will be machine-split into 6 separate 3:4 cards of 1080×1440 px, so compose it as one continuous horizontal strip that reads left to right (final strip size 6480×1440). Output the widest aspect ratio this tool supports — 16:9 is fine; the strip is fitted afterwards. TEMPLATE FAMILY quote-anchor｜金句款. Design grammar: typographic poster layout, one oversized statement per card, tiny supporting caption, one repeating quiet graphic mark. CONTINUOUS STRUCTURE — this is the whole point of the plate: a large soft tonal wash drifting slowly along the whole strip with one thin baseline rule near the lower third, giving each card a different region of the same gradient. Colourway dusk-lilac: soft lilac grey, aubergine, pale peach accent. Surface laid-textile: a fine woven textile weave under softly diffused light. Every 1080 px along the strip is a cut line: keep the design either continuous across those cuts or clear of them, and never place a self-contained motif so that it straddles one. Leave broad calm areas with no detail — headlines, body copy and logos are typeset in Canva on top of this plate, and they need somewhere quiet to land.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
NO TEXT OF ANY KIND — no letters, words, numbers, page numbers, headlines, captions, labels, lorem ipsum, fake glyphs, handwriting or signage in any language. No logo, watermark, signature or AI-tool badge. No human figure, face, hand, animal or recognizable branded product. No card borders, frames, crop marks, seam guides, gutters, drop-shadowed panels or anything that reads as a divided grid of separate cards. No phone mockup, no presentation slide, no surrounding canvas. NO PHOTOGRAPHY ANYWHERE ON THE PLATE — no photographic landscape, interior, sky, foliage, texture photo or photo-realistic fill, not even faint, tinted, cropped inside a frame or used as a corner accent. Photo windows must be left EMPTY: draw the frame outline only and leave the inside as the plain paper ground. Photographs are placed in Canva afterwards at full resolution, because the plate is stretched to fit the strip afterwards and any photograph in it smears into pulp. No high-detail focal subject and no illustrated centrepiece — a plate is a stage, not a picture. No hard vignette, heavy noise, neon glow or blown-out highlight that would fight typography.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. This plate is a background only. Text is typeset on top of it later, so more than half of the surface must stay quiet enough to read 36 px body copy against.
2. Compose as one continuous strip. Any structural element — rule, band, path, torn edge, gradient — must run unbroken from the left edge to the right edge.
3. Self-contained motifs must not straddle a cut line. Either repeat them on a rhythm that clears the cuts, or let the design be genuinely continuous instead.
4. Keep contrast low and even along the whole strip: a plate that is dark at one end and pale at the other produces cards that no longer look like a set.
5. Hold one palette and one texture for the entire plate. Colour variation is delivered as a separate colourway plate, not as drift inside one plate.
6. Output the widest aspect ratio the tool offers at the highest available resolution; the strip is fitted and cut afterwards by scripts/split_carousel.py.
7. Detail level matters more than pixel count here: the plate is stretched several times its generated width, which soft texture survives and fine structure does not.
8. PRE-COMPRESS THE GEOMETRY. You can only output about 2.25:1 but the strip is 6.75:1, so everything you draw is stretched roughly 3× wider afterwards. Draw every arch, frame, circle or motif THREE TIMES NARROWER than it should finally look — a tall narrow arch here becomes a correctly-proportioned arch on the card. Horizontal rules and bands are unaffected.
9. ONE MOTIF PER CARD, evenly spaced. If the set is N cards, place exactly N repeats across the strip, each centred in its own 1/N slice, so no card inherits a motif that has drifted off-centre or been split between two cards.
10. No vertical dividing rules between the repeats. A vertical line at a cut turns the swipe into a row of bordered panels, which is the one thing the plate must never look like.

items.purpose: 8 張連續背景帶
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create ONE wide, seamless, TEXT-FREE background plate for an Instagram carousel. It will be machine-split into 8 separate 3:4 cards of 1080×1440 px, so compose it as one continuous horizontal strip that reads left to right (final strip size 8640×1440). Output the widest aspect ratio this tool supports — 16:9 is fine; the strip is fitted afterwards. TEMPLATE FAMILY myth-buster｜誤解破除款. Design grammar: claim-and-correction layout, struck-through myth chip above a clean correction block, consistent two-tone labelling. CONTINUOUS STRUCTURE — this is the whole point of the plate: two continuous horizontal bands of different tone running the full strip, the upper band slightly darker, so every card inherits the same myth-above / correction-below structure. Colourway cool-editorial: cool off-white, deep navy, soft slate blue accent. Surface soft-glaze: a soft glazed sheen with gentle highlight falloff and no harsh reflection. Every 1080 px along the strip is a cut line: keep the design either continuous across those cuts or clear of them, and never place a self-contained motif so that it straddles one. Leave broad calm areas with no detail — headlines, body copy and logos are typeset in Canva on top of this plate, and they need somewhere quiet to land.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
NO TEXT OF ANY KIND — no letters, words, numbers, page numbers, headlines, captions, labels, lorem ipsum, fake glyphs, handwriting or signage in any language. No logo, watermark, signature or AI-tool badge. No human figure, face, hand, animal or recognizable branded product. No card borders, frames, crop marks, seam guides, gutters, drop-shadowed panels or anything that reads as a divided grid of separate cards. No phone mockup, no presentation slide, no surrounding canvas. NO PHOTOGRAPHY ANYWHERE ON THE PLATE — no photographic landscape, interior, sky, foliage, texture photo or photo-realistic fill, not even faint, tinted, cropped inside a frame or used as a corner accent. Photo windows must be left EMPTY: draw the frame outline only and leave the inside as the plain paper ground. Photographs are placed in Canva afterwards at full resolution, because the plate is stretched to fit the strip afterwards and any photograph in it smears into pulp. No high-detail focal subject and no illustrated centrepiece — a plate is a stage, not a picture. No hard vignette, heavy noise, neon glow or blown-out highlight that would fight typography.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. This plate is a background only. Text is typeset on top of it later, so more than half of the surface must stay quiet enough to read 36 px body copy against.
2. Compose as one continuous strip. Any structural element — rule, band, path, torn edge, gradient — must run unbroken from the left edge to the right edge.
3. Self-contained motifs must not straddle a cut line. Either repeat them on a rhythm that clears the cuts, or let the design be genuinely continuous instead.
4. Keep contrast low and even along the whole strip: a plate that is dark at one end and pale at the other produces cards that no longer look like a set.
5. Hold one palette and one texture for the entire plate. Colour variation is delivered as a separate colourway plate, not as drift inside one plate.
6. Output the widest aspect ratio the tool offers at the highest available resolution; the strip is fitted and cut afterwards by scripts/split_carousel.py.
7. Detail level matters more than pixel count here: the plate is stretched several times its generated width, which soft texture survives and fine structure does not.
8. PRE-COMPRESS THE GEOMETRY. You can only output about 2.25:1 but the strip is 6.75:1, so everything you draw is stretched roughly 3× wider afterwards. Draw every arch, frame, circle or motif THREE TIMES NARROWER than it should finally look — a tall narrow arch here becomes a correctly-proportioned arch on the card. Horizontal rules and bands are unaffected.
9. ONE MOTIF PER CARD, evenly spaced. If the set is N cards, place exactly N repeats across the strip, each centred in its own 1/N slice, so no card inherits a motif that has drifted off-centre or been split between two cards.
10. No vertical dividing rules between the repeats. A vertical line at a cut turns the swipe into a row of bordered panels, which is the one thing the plate must never look like.

items.purpose: 可販售模板｜誤解破除款
items.text: CANVA TEMPLATE SPEC｜誤解破除款（myth-buster）｜百搭 Kit｜誤解破除款（先講迷思 → 逐張糾正，服務業最吃這款）. 1080×1440 px、8 個獨立頁面。設計語法：claim-and-correction layout, struck-through myth chip above a clean correction block, consistent two-tone labelling。字型配對 mono-accent：a clean sans for headlines with a monospace face for labels, numbers and captions。安全邊 80px，切點禁區左右各 80px。把分割出來的卡片當背景，文字全部用可編輯 Canva 文字重打，不要留任何燒進圖裡的字。圖層命名要讓買家看得懂：BACKGROUND / HEADLINE / BODY / LABEL / PHOTO FRAME / PAGE / LOGO / CTA。最多兩個字型家族、三個品牌色。⚠️ 字型只能用可外發的授權（Canva Pro 專屬字型不能用在要交付的模板）。⚠️ 說明書要寫兩句：上傳時把比例從預設 4:5 改成 3:4；要縮成 6–8 張時，優先刪「視覺停頓」與最後一個並列項，永遠保留封面與 CTA。存成 master design，每次客製前先複製，最後產出 Brand Template 連結交付。

briefs.summary: 買家導向行業「商業教練」。今天的組合是「案例拆解款」的故事節奏 × 「活動海報」的視覺語法 × sea-glass 配色 × condensed-impact 字型配對。一天一個產品：9 張母圖 → 分割 → Canva 上字。

items.purpose: 9 張連續背景帶
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create ONE wide, seamless, TEXT-FREE background plate for an Instagram carousel. It will be machine-split into 9 separate 3:4 cards of 1080×1440 px, so compose it as one continuous horizontal strip that reads left to right (final strip size 9720×1440). Output the widest aspect ratio this tool supports — 16:9 is fine; the strip is fitted afterwards. TEMPLATE FAMILY campaign-poster+case-teardown｜活動海報・案例拆解款. Design grammar: confident campaign poster, full-bleed imagery, oversized condensed headline, date badge, offer block and strong action hierarchy. CONTINUOUS STRUCTURE — this is the whole point of the plate: one bold continuous colour field with a single oversized diagonal band sweeping the full length of the strip. Colourway sea-glass: chalk white, deep teal, pale seafoam accent. Surface smooth-matte: a smooth matte finish with no visible texture and very clean edges. Every 1080 px along the strip is a cut line: keep the design either continuous across those cuts or clear of them, and never place a self-contained motif so that it straddles one. Leave broad calm areas with no detail — headlines, body copy and logos are typeset in Canva on top of this plate, and they need somewhere quiet to land.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
NO TEXT OF ANY KIND — no letters, words, numbers, page numbers, headlines, captions, labels, lorem ipsum, fake glyphs, handwriting or signage in any language. No logo, watermark, signature or AI-tool badge. No human figure, face, hand, animal or recognizable branded product. No card borders, frames, crop marks, seam guides, gutters, drop-shadowed panels or anything that reads as a divided grid of separate cards. No phone mockup, no presentation slide, no surrounding canvas. NO PHOTOGRAPHY ANYWHERE ON THE PLATE — no photographic landscape, interior, sky, foliage, texture photo or photo-realistic fill, not even faint, tinted, cropped inside a frame or used as a corner accent. Photo windows must be left EMPTY: draw the frame outline only and leave the inside as the plain paper ground. Photographs are placed in Canva afterwards at full resolution, because the plate is stretched to fit the strip afterwards and any photograph in it smears into pulp. No high-detail focal subject and no illustrated centrepiece — a plate is a stage, not a picture. No hard vignette, heavy noise, neon glow or blown-out highlight that would fight typography.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. This plate is a background only. Text is typeset on top of it later, so more than half of the surface must stay quiet enough to read 36 px body copy against.
2. Compose as one continuous strip. Any structural element — rule, band, path, torn edge, gradient — must run unbroken from the left edge to the right edge.
3. Self-contained motifs must not straddle a cut line. Either repeat them on a rhythm that clears the cuts, or let the design be genuinely continuous instead.
4. Keep contrast low and even along the whole strip: a plate that is dark at one end and pale at the other produces cards that no longer look like a set.
5. Hold one palette and one texture for the entire plate. Colour variation is delivered as a separate colourway plate, not as drift inside one plate.
6. Output the widest aspect ratio the tool offers at the highest available resolution; the strip is fitted and cut afterwards by scripts/split_carousel.py.
7. Detail level matters more than pixel count here: the plate is stretched several times its generated width, which soft texture survives and fine structure does not.
8. PRE-COMPRESS THE GEOMETRY. You can only output about 2.25:1 but the strip is 6.75:1, so everything you draw is stretched roughly 3× wider afterwards. Draw every arch, frame, circle or motif THREE TIMES NARROWER than it should finally look — a tall narrow arch here becomes a correctly-proportioned arch on the card. Horizontal rules and bands are unaffected.
9. ONE MOTIF PER CARD, evenly spaced. If the set is N cards, place exactly N repeats across the strip, each centred in its own 1/N slice, so no card inherits a motif that has drifted off-centre or been split between two cards.
10. No vertical dividing rules between the repeats. A vertical line at a cut turns the swipe into a row of bordered panels, which is the one thing the plate must never look like.

python3 scripts/split_carousel.py campaign-poster_case-teardown_sea-glass.png --cards 9

4. Render only the copy roles this card is assigned. A card that does not need a logo, CTA or hashtag must not show one.
5. Use real, legible Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage) with punctuation, and keep body text at 36 px or larger — a phone reader is holding this at arm's length.

7. Hold the set's brand grammar — palette, type pairing, margin, decorative device — while changing composition and information density from card to card.
8. Body copy must be replaceable: no text baked into a photograph, no headline whose meaning depends on a decorative shape that cannot be moved.
