items.purpose: 可販售模板｜商業教練
items.text: CANVA TEMPLATE SPEC｜活動海報・案例拆解款（campaign-poster+case-teardown）｜商業教練｜知識教育｜一個真實案例，從起點拆到結果. 1080×1440 px、9 個獨立頁面。設計語法：confident campaign poster, full-bleed imagery, oversized condensed headline, date badge, offer block and strong action hierarchy。字型配對 condensed-impact：a tall condensed sans for headlines with a wide-set body face。安全邊 80px，切點禁區左右各 80px。把分割出來的卡片當背景，文字全部用可編輯 Canva 文字重打，不要留任何燒進圖裡的字。圖層命名要讓買家看得懂：BACKGROUND / HEADLINE / BODY / LABEL / PHOTO FRAME / PAGE / LOGO / CTA。最多兩個字型家族、三個品牌色。⚠️ 字型只能用可外發的授權（Canva Pro 專屬字型不能用在要交付的模板）。⚠️ 說明書要寫兩句：上傳時把比例從預設 4:5 改成 3:4；要縮成 6–8 張時，優先刪「視覺停頓」與最後一個並列項，永遠保留封面與 CTA。存成 master design，每次客製前先複製，最後產出 Brand Template 連結交付。

briefs.title: IG 行業包｜房地產仲介｜教學步驟款×瑞士方格
briefs.meta: 第 3 輪・2/9 家｜9 張 3:4｜graphite-coral · grotesk-led · recycled-fleck
briefs.summary: 買家導向行業「房地產仲介」。今天的組合是「教學步驟款」的故事節奏 × 「瑞士方格」的視覺語法 × graphite-coral 配色 × grotesk-led 字型配對。一天一個產品：9 張母圖 → 分割 → Canva 上字。

items.purpose: 9 張連續背景帶
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create ONE wide, seamless, TEXT-FREE background plate for an Instagram carousel. It will be machine-split into 9 separate 3:4 cards of 1080×1440 px, so compose it as one continuous horizontal strip that reads left to right (final strip size 9720×1440). Output the widest aspect ratio this tool supports — 16:9 is fine; the strip is fitted afterwards. TEMPLATE FAMILY swiss-grid+step-path｜瑞士方格・教學步驟款. Design grammar: strict international-style grid, flush-left hierarchy, thick horizontal rules, one solid accent block per page, mathematical spacing. CONTINUOUS STRUCTURE — this is the whole point of the plate: a continuous set of thick horizontal rules at fixed intervals with one solid accent band running the entire length at a constant height. Colourway graphite-coral: light graphite grey, off-black, warm coral accent. Surface recycled-fleck: recycled stock with tiny darker flecks and slightly irregular edges. Every 1080 px along the strip is a cut line: keep the design either continuous across those cuts or clear of them, and never place a self-contained motif so that it straddles one. Leave broad calm areas with no detail — headlines, body copy and logos are typeset in Canva on top of this plate, and they need somewhere quiet to land.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
NO TEXT OF ANY KIND — no letters, words, numbers, page numbers, headlines, captions, labels, lorem ipsum, fake glyphs, handwriting or signage in any language. No logo, watermark, signature or AI-tool badge. No human figure, face, hand, animal or recognizable branded product. No card borders, frames, crop marks, seam guides, gutters, drop-shadowed panels or anything that reads as a divided grid of separate cards. No phone mockup, no presentation slide, no surrounding canvas. NO PHOTOGRAPHY ANYWHERE ON THE PLATE — no photographic landscape, interior, sky, foliage, texture photo or photo-realistic fill, not even faint, tinted, cropped inside a frame or used as a corner accent. Photo windows must be left EMPTY: draw the frame outline only and leave the inside as the plain paper ground. Photographs are placed in Canva afterwards at full resolution, because the plate is stretched to fit the strip afterwards and any photograph in it smears into pulp. No high-detail focal subject and no illustrated centrepiece — a plate is a stage, not a picture. No hard vignette, heavy noise, neon glow or blown-out highlight that would fight typography.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. This plate is a background only. Text is typeset on top of it later, so more than half of the surface must stay quiet enough to read 36 px body copy against.
2. Compose as one continuous strip. Any structural element — rule, band, path, torn edge, gradient — must run unbroken from the left edge to the right edge.
3. Self-contained motifs must not straddle a cut line. Either repeat them on a rhythm that clears the cuts, or let the design be genuinely continuous instead.
4. Keep contrast low and even along the whole strip: a plate that is dark at one end and pale at the other produces cards that no longer look like a set.
5. Hold one palette and one texture for the entire plate. Colour variation is delivered as a separate colourway plate, not as drift inside one plate.
6. Output the widest aspect ratio the tool offers at the highest available resolution; the strip is fitted and cut afterwards by scripts/split_carousel.py.
7. Detail level matters more than pixel count here: the plate is stretched several times its generated width, which soft texture survives and fine structure does not.
8. PRE-COMPRESS THE GEOMETRY. You can only output about 2.25:1 but the strip is 6.75:1, so everything you draw is stretched roughly 3× wider afterwards. Draw every arch, frame, circle or motif THREE TIMES NARROWER than it should finally look — a tall narrow arch here becomes a correctly-proportioned arch on the card. Horizontal rules and bands are unaffected.
9. ONE MOTIF PER CARD, evenly spaced. If the set is N cards, place exactly N repeats across the strip, each centred in its own 1/N slice, so no card inherits a motif that has drifted off-centre or been split between two cards.
10. No vertical dividing rules between the repeats. A vertical line at a cut turns the swipe into a row of bordered panels, which is the one thing the plate must never look like.

briefs.summary: 買家導向行業「攝影師」。今天的組合是「客戶疑慮款」的故事節奏 × 「孔版疊印」的視覺語法 × warm-neutral 配色 × serif-led 字型配對。一天一個產品：7 張母圖 → 分割 → Canva 上字。

items.purpose: 7 張連續背景帶
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create ONE wide, seamless, TEXT-FREE background plate for an Instagram carousel. It will be machine-split into 7 separate 3:4 cards of 1080×1440 px, so compose it as one continuous horizontal strip that reads left to right (final strip size 7560×1440). Output the widest aspect ratio this tool supports — 16:9 is fine; the strip is fitted afterwards. TEMPLATE FAMILY riso-overprint+faq-concerns｜孔版疊印・客戶疑慮款. Design grammar: two-ink risograph overprint, visible halftone dots, deliberate slight misregistration, paper white showing through, flat shapes. CONTINUOUS STRUCTURE — this is the whole point of the plate: two large overlapping ink fields travelling the whole strip with a halftone dot gradient in the overlap and a constant 2 mm misregistration offset. Colourway warm-neutral: warm cream paper, espresso brown, muted sage accent. Surface uncoated-paper: matte uncoated paper grain with a barely-visible film grain. Every 1080 px along the strip is a cut line: keep the design either continuous across those cuts or clear of them, and never place a self-contained motif so that it straddles one. Leave broad calm areas with no detail — headlines, body copy and logos are typeset in Canva on top of this plate, and they need somewhere quiet to land.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
NO TEXT OF ANY KIND — no letters, words, numbers, page numbers, headlines, captions, labels, lorem ipsum, fake glyphs, handwriting or signage in any language. No logo, watermark, signature or AI-tool badge. No human figure, face, hand, animal or recognizable branded product. No card borders, frames, crop marks, seam guides, gutters, drop-shadowed panels or anything that reads as a divided grid of separate cards. No phone mockup, no presentation slide, no surrounding canvas. NO PHOTOGRAPHY ANYWHERE ON THE PLATE — no photographic landscape, interior, sky, foliage, texture photo or photo-realistic fill, not even faint, tinted, cropped inside a frame or used as a corner accent. Photo windows must be left EMPTY: draw the frame outline only and leave the inside as the plain paper ground. Photographs are placed in Canva afterwards at full resolution, because the plate is stretched to fit the strip afterwards and any photograph in it smears into pulp. No high-detail focal subject and no illustrated centrepiece — a plate is a stage, not a picture. No hard vignette, heavy noise, neon glow or blown-out highlight that would fight typography.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. This plate is a background only. Text is typeset on top of it later, so more than half of the surface must stay quiet enough to read 36 px body copy against.
2. Compose as one continuous strip. Any structural element — rule, band, path, torn edge, gradient — must run unbroken from the left edge to the right edge.
3. Self-contained motifs must not straddle a cut line. Either repeat them on a rhythm that clears the cuts, or let the design be genuinely continuous instead.
4. Keep contrast low and even along the whole strip: a plate that is dark at one end and pale at the other produces cards that no longer look like a set.
5. Hold one palette and one texture for the entire plate. Colour variation is delivered as a separate colourway plate, not as drift inside one plate.
6. Output the widest aspect ratio the tool offers at the highest available resolution; the strip is fitted and cut afterwards by scripts/split_carousel.py.
7. Detail level matters more than pixel count here: the plate is stretched several times its generated width, which soft texture survives and fine structure does not.
8. PRE-COMPRESS THE GEOMETRY. You can only output about 2.25:1 but the strip is 6.75:1, so everything you draw is stretched roughly 3× wider afterwards. Draw every arch, frame, circle or motif THREE TIMES NARROWER than it should finally look — a tall narrow arch here becomes a correctly-proportioned arch on the card. Horizontal rules and bands are unaffected.
9. ONE MOTIF PER CARD, evenly spaced. If the set is N cards, place exactly N repeats across the strip, each centred in its own 1/N slice, so no card inherits a motif that has drifted off-centre or been split between two cards.
10. No vertical dividing rules between the repeats. A vertical line at a cut turns the swipe into a row of bordered panels, which is the one thing the plate must never look like.

items.purpose: 母圖 → 7 張卡片
items.text:
python3 scripts/split_carousel.py riso-overprint_faq-concerns_warm-neutral.png --cards 7
→ 輸出 7 張 1080×1440 卡片 + `_seam_preview.png`。
先看 seam preview：紅帶是每個切點左右各 80px 的禁區，有裝飾或主體被切開就回頭改母圖，不要硬上。
母圖是抽象紋理才用預設 `--fit stretch`；若母圖有拱門、照片框、物件等可辨識結構，改用 `--fit cover`（保幾何但裁掉大部分高度）。

briefs.summary: 買家導向行業「線上課程創作者」。今天的組合是「前後對比款」的故事節奏 × 「裝飾線框」的視覺語法 × ink-and-butter 配色 × editorial-mix 字型配對。一天一個產品：8 張母圖 → 分割 → Canva 上字。

items.purpose: 8 張連續背景帶
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create ONE wide, seamless, TEXT-FREE background plate for an Instagram carousel. It will be machine-split into 8 separate 3:4 cards of 1080×1440 px, so compose it as one continuous horizontal strip that reads left to right (final strip size 8640×1440). Output the widest aspect ratio this tool supports — 16:9 is fine; the strip is fitted afterwards. TEMPLATE FAMILY deco-frame+before-after｜裝飾線框・前後對比款. Design grammar: art-deco geometry, stepped corner frames, thin repeated rules, symmetrical composition, small fan and sunburst motifs. CONTINUOUS STRUCTURE — this is the whole point of the plate: one continuous stepped border rule running along the top and bottom of the strip with evenly repeating thin vertical fluting between. Colourway ink-and-butter: soft butter yellow, near-black ink, warm grey accent. Surface laid-textile: a fine woven textile weave under softly diffused light. Every 1080 px along the strip is a cut line: keep the design either continuous across those cuts or clear of them, and never place a self-contained motif so that it straddles one. Leave broad calm areas with no detail — headlines, body copy and logos are typeset in Canva on top of this plate, and they need somewhere quiet to land.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
NO TEXT OF ANY KIND — no letters, words, numbers, page numbers, headlines, captions, labels, lorem ipsum, fake glyphs, handwriting or signage in any language. No logo, watermark, signature or AI-tool badge. No human figure, face, hand, animal or recognizable branded product. No card borders, frames, crop marks, seam guides, gutters, drop-shadowed panels or anything that reads as a divided grid of separate cards. No phone mockup, no presentation slide, no surrounding canvas. NO PHOTOGRAPHY ANYWHERE ON THE PLATE — no photographic landscape, interior, sky, foliage, texture photo or photo-realistic fill, not even faint, tinted, cropped inside a frame or used as a corner accent. Photo windows must be left EMPTY: draw the frame outline only and leave the inside as the plain paper ground. Photographs are placed in Canva afterwards at full resolution, because the plate is stretched to fit the strip afterwards and any photograph in it smears into pulp. No high-detail focal subject and no illustrated centrepiece — a plate is a stage, not a picture. No hard vignette, heavy noise, neon glow or blown-out highlight that would fight typography.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. This plate is a background only. Text is typeset on top of it later, so more than half of the surface must stay quiet enough to read 36 px body copy against.
2. Compose as one continuous strip. Any structural element — rule, band, path, torn edge, gradient — must run unbroken from the left edge to the right edge.
3. Self-contained motifs must not straddle a cut line. Either repeat them on a rhythm that clears the cuts, or let the design be genuinely continuous instead.
4. Keep contrast low and even along the whole strip: a plate that is dark at one end and pale at the other produces cards that no longer look like a set.
5. Hold one palette and one texture for the entire plate. Colour variation is delivered as a separate colourway plate, not as drift inside one plate.
6. Output the widest aspect ratio the tool offers at the highest available resolution; the strip is fitted and cut afterwards by scripts/split_carousel.py.
7. Detail level matters more than pixel count here: the plate is stretched several times its generated width, which soft texture survives and fine structure does not.
8. PRE-COMPRESS THE GEOMETRY. You can only output about 2.25:1 but the strip is 6.75:1, so everything you draw is stretched roughly 3× wider afterwards. Draw every arch, frame, circle or motif THREE TIMES NARROWER than it should finally look — a tall narrow arch here becomes a correctly-proportioned arch on the card. Horizontal rules and bands are unaffected.
9. ONE MOTIF PER CARD, evenly spaced. If the set is N cards, place exactly N repeats across the strip, each centred in its own 1/N slice, so no card inherits a motif that has drifted off-centre or been split between two cards.
10. No vertical dividing rules between the repeats. A vertical line at a cut turns the swipe into a row of bordered panels, which is the one thing the plate must never look like.

items.purpose: 母圖 → 8 張卡片

items.purpose: 8 張連續背景帶
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create ONE wide, seamless, TEXT-FREE background plate for an Instagram carousel. It will be machine-split into 8 separate 3:4 cards of 1080×1440 px, so compose it as one continuous horizontal strip that reads left to right (final strip size 8640×1440). Output the widest aspect ratio this tool supports — 16:9 is fine; the strip is fitted afterwards. TEMPLATE FAMILY gallery-label+myth-buster｜展間掛牌・誤解破除款. Design grammar: museum wall labels, very generous white space, hairline picture frames, small caption plates, centred restraint. CONTINUOUS STRUCTURE — this is the whole point of the plate: a long uninterrupted pale wall field with one hairline horizontal hanging rail crossing the entire strip at eye level. Colourway forest-linen: natural linen, deep forest green, pale gold accent. Surface soft-glaze: a soft glazed sheen with gentle highlight falloff and no harsh reflection. Every 1080 px along the strip is a cut line: keep the design either continuous across those cuts or clear of them, and never place a self-contained motif so that it straddles one. Leave broad calm areas with no detail — headlines, body copy and logos are typeset in Canva on top of this plate, and they need somewhere quiet to land.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
NO TEXT OF ANY KIND — no letters, words, numbers, page numbers, headlines, captions, labels, lorem ipsum, fake glyphs, handwriting or signage in any language. No logo, watermark, signature or AI-tool badge. No human figure, face, hand, animal or recognizable branded product. No card borders, frames, crop marks, seam guides, gutters, drop-shadowed panels or anything that reads as a divided grid of separate cards. No phone mockup, no presentation slide, no surrounding canvas. NO PHOTOGRAPHY ANYWHERE ON THE PLATE — no photographic landscape, interior, sky, foliage, texture photo or photo-realistic fill, not even faint, tinted, cropped inside a frame or used as a corner accent. Photo windows must be left EMPTY: draw the frame outline only and leave the inside as the plain paper ground. Photographs are placed in Canva afterwards at full resolution, because the plate is stretched to fit the strip afterwards and any photograph in it smears into pulp. No high-detail focal subject and no illustrated centrepiece — a plate is a stage, not a picture. No hard vignette, heavy noise, neon glow or blown-out highlight that would fight typography.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. This plate is a background only. Text is typeset on top of it later, so more than half of the surface must stay quiet enough to read 36 px body copy against.
2. Compose as one continuous strip. Any structural element — rule, band, path, torn edge, gradient — must run unbroken from the left edge to the right edge.
3. Self-contained motifs must not straddle a cut line. Either repeat them on a rhythm that clears the cuts, or let the design be genuinely continuous instead.
4. Keep contrast low and even along the whole strip: a plate that is dark at one end and pale at the other produces cards that no longer look like a set.
5. Hold one palette and one texture for the entire plate. Colour variation is delivered as a separate colourway plate, not as drift inside one plate.
6. Output the widest aspect ratio the tool offers at the highest available resolution; the strip is fitted and cut afterwards by scripts/split_carousel.py.
7. Detail level matters more than pixel count here: the plate is stretched several times its generated width, which soft texture survives and fine structure does not.
8. PRE-COMPRESS THE GEOMETRY. You can only output about 2.25:1 but the strip is 6.75:1, so everything you draw is stretched roughly 3× wider afterwards. Draw every arch, frame, circle or motif THREE TIMES NARROWER than it should finally look — a tall narrow arch here becomes a correctly-proportioned arch on the card. Horizontal rules and bands are unaffected.
9. ONE MOTIF PER CARD, evenly spaced. If the set is N cards, place exactly N repeats across the strip, each centred in its own 1/N slice, so no card inherits a motif that has drifted off-centre or been split between two cards.
10. No vertical dividing rules between the repeats. A vertical line at a cut turns the swipe into a row of bordered panels, which is the one thing the plate must never look like.

items.purpose: 母圖 → 8 張卡片

python3 scripts/split_carousel.py gallery-label_myth-buster_forest-linen.png --cards 8

items.text: CANVA TEMPLATE SPEC｜展間掛牌・誤解破除款（gallery-label+myth-buster）｜營養師／健身教練｜知識教育｜先講迷思 → 逐張糾正，服務業最吃這款. 1080×1440 px、8 個獨立頁面。設計語法：museum wall labels, very generous white space, hairline picture frames, small caption plates, centred restraint。字型配對 rounded-warm：one soft rounded sans throughout, with weight contrast doing all the hierarchy work。安全邊 80px，切點禁區左右各 80px。把分割出來的卡片當背景，文字全部用可編輯 Canva 文字重打，不要留任何燒進圖裡的字。圖層命名要讓買家看得懂：BACKGROUND / HEADLINE / BODY / LABEL / PHOTO FRAME / PAGE / LOGO / CTA。最多兩個字型家族、三個品牌色。⚠️ 字型只能用可外發的授權（Canva Pro 專屬字型不能用在要交付的模板）。⚠️ 說明書要寫兩句：上傳時把比例從預設 4:5 改成 3:4；要縮成 6–8 張時，優先刪「視覺停頓」與最後一個並列項，永遠保留封面與 CTA。存成 master design，每次客製前先複製，最後產出 Brand Template 連結交付。

briefs.title: IG 行業包｜婚禮策劃｜列表款×柔霧漸層
briefs.meta: 第 3 輪・6/9 家｜9 張 3:4｜sand-cobalt · mono-accent · smooth-matte
briefs.summary: 買家導向行業「婚禮策劃」。今天的組合是「列表款」的故事節奏 × 「柔霧漸層」的視覺語法 × sand-cobalt 配色 × mono-accent 字型配對。一天一個產品：9 張母圖 → 分割 → Canva 上字。

items.purpose: 9 張連續背景帶
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create ONE wide, seamless, TEXT-FREE background plate for an Instagram carousel. It will be machine-split into 9 separate 3:4 cards of 1080×1440 px, so compose it as one continuous horizontal strip that reads left to right (final strip size 9720×1440). Output the widest aspect ratio this tool supports — 16:9 is fine; the strip is fitted afterwards. TEMPLATE FAMILY soft-gradient-panels+list-stack｜柔霧漸層・列表款. Design grammar: soft mesh-gradient fields with no hard edges, frosted translucent panels, gentle inner glow, rounded corners. CONTINUOUS STRUCTURE — this is the whole point of the plate: one slow continuous mesh gradient drifting through the palette from one end of the strip to the other, with no discrete shapes at all. Colourway sand-cobalt: warm sand, strong cobalt blue, chalk white accent. Surface smooth-matte: a smooth matte finish with no visible texture and very clean edges. Every 1080 px along the strip is a cut line: keep the design either continuous across those cuts or clear of them, and never place a self-contained motif so that it straddles one. Leave broad calm areas with no detail — headlines, body copy and logos are typeset in Canva on top of this plate, and they need somewhere quiet to land.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
NO TEXT OF ANY KIND — no letters, words, numbers, page numbers, headlines, captions, labels, lorem ipsum, fake glyphs, handwriting or signage in any language. No logo, watermark, signature or AI-tool badge. No human figure, face, hand, animal or recognizable branded product. No card borders, frames, crop marks, seam guides, gutters, drop-shadowed panels or anything that reads as a divided grid of separate cards. No phone mockup, no presentation slide, no surrounding canvas. NO PHOTOGRAPHY ANYWHERE ON THE PLATE — no photographic landscape, interior, sky, foliage, texture photo or photo-realistic fill, not even faint, tinted, cropped inside a frame or used as a corner accent. Photo windows must be left EMPTY: draw the frame outline only and leave the inside as the plain paper ground. Photographs are placed in Canva afterwards at full resolution, because the plate is stretched to fit the strip afterwards and any photograph in it smears into pulp. No high-detail focal subject and no illustrated centrepiece — a plate is a stage, not a picture. No hard vignette, heavy noise, neon glow or blown-out highlight that would fight typography.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. This plate is a background only. Text is typeset on top of it later, so more than half of the surface must stay quiet enough to read 36 px body copy against.
2. Compose as one continuous strip. Any structural element — rule, band, path, torn edge, gradient — must run unbroken from the left edge to the right edge.
3. Self-contained motifs must not straddle a cut line. Either repeat them on a rhythm that clears the cuts, or let the design be genuinely continuous instead.
4. Keep contrast low and even along the whole strip: a plate that is dark at one end and pale at the other produces cards that no longer look like a set.
5. Hold one palette and one texture for the entire plate. Colour variation is delivered as a separate colourway plate, not as drift inside one plate.
6. Output the widest aspect ratio the tool offers at the highest available resolution; the strip is fitted and cut afterwards by scripts/split_carousel.py.
7. Detail level matters more than pixel count here: the plate is stretched several times its generated width, which soft texture survives and fine structure does not.
8. PRE-COMPRESS THE GEOMETRY. You can only output about 2.25:1 but the strip is 6.75:1, so everything you draw is stretched roughly 3× wider afterwards. Draw every arch, frame, circle or motif THREE TIMES NARROWER than it should finally look — a tall narrow arch here becomes a correctly-proportioned arch on the card. Horizontal rules and bands are unaffected.
9. ONE MOTIF PER CARD, evenly spaced. If the set is N cards, place exactly N repeats across the strip, each centred in its own 1/N slice, so no card inherits a motif that has drifted off-centre or been split between two cards.
10. No vertical dividing rules between the repeats. A vertical line at a cut turns the swipe into a row of bordered panels, which is the one thing the plate must never look like.

items.purpose: 母圖 → 9 張卡片
items.text:
python3 scripts/split_carousel.py soft-gradient-panels_list-stack_sand-cobalt.png --cards 9
→ 輸出 9 張 1080×1440 卡片 + `_seam_preview.png`。
先看 seam preview：紅帶是每個切點左右各 80px 的禁區，有裝飾或主體被切開就回頭改母圖，不要硬上。
母圖是抽象紋理才用預設 `--fit stretch`；若母圖有拱門、照片框、物件等可辨識結構，改用 `--fit cover`（保幾何但裁掉大部分高度）。

items.text: CANVA TEMPLATE SPEC｜柔霧漸層・列表款（soft-gradient-panels+list-stack）｜婚禮策劃｜知識教育｜N 個重點／N 個常見錯誤. 1080×1440 px、9 個獨立頁面。設計語法：soft mesh-gradient fields with no hard edges, frosted translucent panels, gentle inner glow, rounded corners。字型配對 mono-accent：a clean sans for headlines with a monospace face for labels, numbers and captions。安全邊 80px，切點禁區左右各 80px。把分割出來的卡片當背景，文字全部用可編輯 Canva 文字重打，不要留任何燒進圖裡的字。圖層命名要讓買家看得懂：BACKGROUND / HEADLINE / BODY / LABEL / PHOTO FRAME / PAGE / LOGO / CTA。最多兩個字型家族、三個品牌色。⚠️ 字型只能用可外發的授權（Canva Pro 專屬字型不能用在要交付的模板）。⚠️ 說明書要寫兩句：上傳時把比例從預設 4:5 改成 3:4；要縮成 6–8 張時，優先刪「視覺停頓」與最後一個並列項，永遠保留封面與 CTA。存成 master design，每次客製前先複製，最後產出 Brand Template 連結交付。

briefs.title: IG 行業包｜美業個人工作室｜金句款×紙膠拼貼
briefs.meta: 第 3 輪・7/9 家｜6 張 3:4｜soft-clay · condensed-impact · recycled-fleck
briefs.summary: 買家導向行業「美業個人工作室」。今天的組合是「金句款」的故事節奏 × 「紙膠拼貼」的視覺語法 × soft-clay 配色 × condensed-impact 字型配對。一天一個產品：6 張母圖 → 分割 → Canva 上字。

items.purpose: 6 張連續背景帶
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create ONE wide, seamless, TEXT-FREE background plate for an Instagram carousel. It will be machine-split into 6 separate 3:4 cards of 1080×1440 px, so compose it as one continuous horizontal strip that reads left to right (final strip size 6480×1440). Output the widest aspect ratio this tool supports — 16:9 is fine; the strip is fitted afterwards. TEMPLATE FAMILY paper-collage+quote-anchor｜紙膠拼貼・金句款. Design grammar: cut-paper collage, torn and scissor-cut edges, washi tape strips, layered shapes with soft contact shadow. CONTINUOUS STRUCTURE — this is the whole point of the plate: a continuous band of overlapping torn paper layers marching across the strip, with tape strips crossing at irregular intervals. Colourway soft-clay: pale oat, terracotta clay, dusty rose accent. Surface recycled-fleck: recycled stock with tiny darker flecks and slightly irregular edges. Every 1080 px along the strip is a cut line: keep the design either continuous across those cuts or clear of them, and never place a self-contained motif so that it straddles one. Leave broad calm areas with no detail — headlines, body copy and logos are typeset in Canva on top of this plate, and they need somewhere quiet to land.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
NO TEXT OF ANY KIND — no letters, words, numbers, page numbers, headlines, captions, labels, lorem ipsum, fake glyphs, handwriting or signage in any language. No logo, watermark, signature or AI-tool badge. No human figure, face, hand, animal or recognizable branded product. No card borders, frames, crop marks, seam guides, gutters, drop-shadowed panels or anything that reads as a divided grid of separate cards. No phone mockup, no presentation slide, no surrounding canvas. NO PHOTOGRAPHY ANYWHERE ON THE PLATE — no photographic landscape, interior, sky, foliage, texture photo or photo-realistic fill, not even faint, tinted, cropped inside a frame or used as a corner accent. Photo windows must be left EMPTY: draw the frame outline only and leave the inside as the plain paper ground. Photographs are placed in Canva afterwards at full resolution, because the plate is stretched to fit the strip afterwards and any photograph in it smears into pulp. No high-detail focal subject and no illustrated centrepiece — a plate is a stage, not a picture. No hard vignette, heavy noise, neon glow or blown-out highlight that would fight typography.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. This plate is a background only. Text is typeset on top of it later, so more than half of the surface must stay quiet enough to read 36 px body copy against.
2. Compose as one continuous strip. Any structural element — rule, band, path, torn edge, gradient — must run unbroken from the left edge to the right edge.
3. Self-contained motifs must not straddle a cut line. Either repeat them on a rhythm that clears the cuts, or let the design be genuinely continuous instead.
4. Keep contrast low and even along the whole strip: a plate that is dark at one end and pale at the other produces cards that no longer look like a set.
5. Hold one palette and one texture for the entire plate. Colour variation is delivered as a separate colourway plate, not as drift inside one plate.
6. Output the widest aspect ratio the tool offers at the highest available resolution; the strip is fitted and cut afterwards by scripts/split_carousel.py.
7. Detail level matters more than pixel count here: the plate is stretched several times its generated width, which soft texture survives and fine structure does not.
8. PRE-COMPRESS THE GEOMETRY. You can only output about 2.25:1 but the strip is 6.75:1, so everything you draw is stretched roughly 3× wider afterwards. Draw every arch, frame, circle or motif THREE TIMES NARROWER than it should finally look — a tall narrow arch here becomes a correctly-proportioned arch on the card. Horizontal rules and bands are unaffected.
9. ONE MOTIF PER CARD, evenly spaced. If the set is N cards, place exactly N repeats across the strip, each centred in its own 1/N slice, so no card inherits a motif that has drifted off-centre or been split between two cards.
10. No vertical dividing rules between the repeats. A vertical line at a cut turns the swipe into a row of bordered panels, which is the one thing the plate must never look like.

items.purpose: 9 張連續背景帶
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create ONE wide, seamless, TEXT-FREE background plate for an Instagram carousel. It will be machine-split into 9 separate 3:4 cards of 1080×1440 px, so compose it as one continuous horizontal strip that reads left to right (final strip size 9720×1440). Output the widest aspect ratio this tool supports — 16:9 is fine; the strip is fitted afterwards. TEMPLATE FAMILY mono-datasheet+case-teardown｜等寬資料頁・案例拆解款. Design grammar: monospace technical data sheet, thin keylines, small-caps field labels, tabular rhythm, one highlighted row. CONTINUOUS STRUCTURE — this is the whole point of the plate: a continuous fine keyline table grid running the full width with one tinted row band travelling the entire strip. Colourway plum-paper: warm grey paper, deep plum, muted apricot accent. Surface uncoated-paper: matte uncoated paper grain with a barely-visible film grain. Every 1080 px along the strip is a cut line: keep the design either continuous across those cuts or clear of them, and never place a self-contained motif so that it straddles one. Leave broad calm areas with no detail — headlines, body copy and logos are typeset in Canva on top of this plate, and they need somewhere quiet to land.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
NO TEXT OF ANY KIND — no letters, words, numbers, page numbers, headlines, captions, labels, lorem ipsum, fake glyphs, handwriting or signage in any language. No logo, watermark, signature or AI-tool badge. No human figure, face, hand, animal or recognizable branded product. No card borders, frames, crop marks, seam guides, gutters, drop-shadowed panels or anything that reads as a divided grid of separate cards. No phone mockup, no presentation slide, no surrounding canvas. NO PHOTOGRAPHY ANYWHERE ON THE PLATE — no photographic landscape, interior, sky, foliage, texture photo or photo-realistic fill, not even faint, tinted, cropped inside a frame or used as a corner accent. Photo windows must be left EMPTY: draw the frame outline only and leave the inside as the plain paper ground. Photographs are placed in Canva afterwards at full resolution, because the plate is stretched to fit the strip afterwards and any photograph in it smears into pulp. No high-detail focal subject and no illustrated centrepiece — a plate is a stage, not a picture. No hard vignette, heavy noise, neon glow or blown-out highlight that would fight typography.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. This plate is a background only. Text is typeset on top of it later, so more than half of the surface must stay quiet enough to read 36 px body copy against.
2. Compose as one continuous strip. Any structural element — rule, band, path, torn edge, gradient — must run unbroken from the left edge to the right edge.
3. Self-contained motifs must not straddle a cut line. Either repeat them on a rhythm that clears the cuts, or let the design be genuinely continuous instead.
4. Keep contrast low and even along the whole strip: a plate that is dark at one end and pale at the other produces cards that no longer look like a set.
5. Hold one palette and one texture for the entire plate. Colour variation is delivered as a separate colourway plate, not as drift inside one plate.
6. Output the widest aspect ratio the tool offers at the highest available resolution; the strip is fitted and cut afterwards by scripts/split_carousel.py.
7. Detail level matters more than pixel count here: the plate is stretched several times its generated width, which soft texture survives and fine structure does not.
8. PRE-COMPRESS THE GEOMETRY. You can only output about 2.25:1 but the strip is 6.75:1, so everything you draw is stretched roughly 3× wider afterwards. Draw every arch, frame, circle or motif THREE TIMES NARROWER than it should finally look — a tall narrow arch here becomes a correctly-proportioned arch on the card. Horizontal rules and bands are unaffected.
9. ONE MOTIF PER CARD, evenly spaced. If the set is N cards, place exactly N repeats across the strip, each centred in its own 1/N slice, so no card inherits a motif that has drifted off-centre or been split between two cards.
10. No vertical dividing rules between the repeats. A vertical line at a cut turns the swipe into a row of bordered panels, which is the one thing the plate must never look like.

items.purpose: 母圖 → 9 張卡片

items.text: CANVA TEMPLATE SPEC｜等寬資料頁・案例拆解款（mono-datasheet+case-teardown）｜寵物服務｜知識教育｜一個真實案例，從起點拆到結果. 1080×1440 px、9 個獨立頁面。設計語法：monospace technical data sheet, thin keylines, small-caps field labels, tabular rhythm, one highlighted row。字型配對 grotesk-led：a bold neo-grotesk for headlines with a lighter weight of the same family for body。安全邊 80px，切點禁區左右各 80px。把分割出來的卡片當背景，文字全部用可編輯 Canva 文字重打，不要留任何燒進圖裡的字。圖層命名要讓買家看得懂：BACKGROUND / HEADLINE / BODY / LABEL / PHOTO FRAME / PAGE / LOGO / CTA。最多兩個字型家族、三個品牌色。⚠️ 字型只能用可外發的授權（Canva Pro 專屬字型不能用在要交付的模板）。⚠️ 說明書要寫兩句：上傳時把比例從預設 4:5 改成 3:4；要縮成 6–8 張時，優先刪「視覺停頓」與最後一個並列項，永遠保留封面與 CTA。存成 master design，每次客製前先複製，最後產出 Brand Template 連結交付。

briefs.summary: 買家導向行業「獨立咖啡店」。今天的組合是「教學步驟款」的故事節奏 × 「報紙專欄」的視覺語法 × dusk-lilac 配色 × serif-led 字型配對。一天一個產品：9 張母圖 → 分割 → Canva 上字。

items.purpose: 9 張連續背景帶
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create ONE wide, seamless, TEXT-FREE background plate for an Instagram carousel. It will be machine-split into 9 separate 3:4 cards of 1080×1440 px, so compose it as one continuous horizontal strip that reads left to right (final strip size 9720×1440). Output the widest aspect ratio this tool supports — 16:9 is fine; the strip is fitted afterwards. TEMPLATE FAMILY broadsheet-column+step-path｜報紙專欄・教學步驟款. Design grammar: newspaper broadsheet columns, hairline column rules, drop caps, dense masthead-style headline stack, small photo boxes. CONTINUOUS STRUCTURE — this is the whole point of the plate: unbroken vertical column rules at even spacing across the whole strip with one heavier masthead rule near the top. Colourway dusk-lilac: soft lilac grey, aubergine, pale peach accent. Surface laid-textile: a fine woven textile weave under softly diffused light. Every 1080 px along the strip is a cut line: keep the design either continuous across those cuts or clear of them, and never place a self-contained motif so that it straddles one. Leave broad calm areas with no detail — headlines, body copy and logos are typeset in Canva on top of this plate, and they need somewhere quiet to land.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
NO TEXT OF ANY KIND — no letters, words, numbers, page numbers, headlines, captions, labels, lorem ipsum, fake glyphs, handwriting or signage in any language. No logo, watermark, signature or AI-tool badge. No human figure, face, hand, animal or recognizable branded product. No card borders, frames, crop marks, seam guides, gutters, drop-shadowed panels or anything that reads as a divided grid of separate cards. No phone mockup, no presentation slide, no surrounding canvas. NO PHOTOGRAPHY ANYWHERE ON THE PLATE — no photographic landscape, interior, sky, foliage, texture photo or photo-realistic fill, not even faint, tinted, cropped inside a frame or used as a corner accent. Photo windows must be left EMPTY: draw the frame outline only and leave the inside as the plain paper ground. Photographs are placed in Canva afterwards at full resolution, because the plate is stretched to fit the strip afterwards and any photograph in it smears into pulp. No high-detail focal subject and no illustrated centrepiece — a plate is a stage, not a picture. No hard vignette, heavy noise, neon glow or blown-out highlight that would fight typography.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. This plate is a background only. Text is typeset on top of it later, so more than half of the surface must stay quiet enough to read 36 px body copy against.
2. Compose as one continuous strip. Any structural element — rule, band, path, torn edge, gradient — must run unbroken from the left edge to the right edge.
3. Self-contained motifs must not straddle a cut line. Either repeat them on a rhythm that clears the cuts, or let the design be genuinely continuous instead.
4. Keep contrast low and even along the whole strip: a plate that is dark at one end and pale at the other produces cards that no longer look like a set.
5. Hold one palette and one texture for the entire plate. Colour variation is delivered as a separate colourway plate, not as drift inside one plate.
6. Output the widest aspect ratio the tool offers at the highest available resolution; the strip is fitted and cut afterwards by scripts/split_carousel.py.
7. Detail level matters more than pixel count here: the plate is stretched several times its generated width, which soft texture survives and fine structure does not.
8. PRE-COMPRESS THE GEOMETRY. You can only output about 2.25:1 but the strip is 6.75:1, so everything you draw is stretched roughly 3× wider afterwards. Draw every arch, frame, circle or motif THREE TIMES NARROWER than it should finally look — a tall narrow arch here becomes a correctly-proportioned arch on the card. Horizontal rules and bands are unaffected.
9. ONE MOTIF PER CARD, evenly spaced. If the set is N cards, place exactly N repeats across the strip, each centred in its own 1/N slice, so no card inherits a motif that has drifted off-centre or been split between two cards.
10. No vertical dividing rules between the repeats. A vertical line at a cut turns the swipe into a row of bordered panels, which is the one thing the plate must never look like.

Typeset card 9/9 of one Instagram carousel set, 3:4 at 1080×1440 px, edge to edge. Output ONE standalone card. Context: 獨立咖啡店｜知識教育｜Step 1…N，最容易被存檔. TEMPLATE FAMILY broadsheet-column+step-path｜報紙專欄・教學步驟款; design grammar: newspaper broadsheet columns, hairline column rules, drop caps, dense masthead-style headline stack, small photo boxes; colourway dusk-lilac: soft lilac grey, aubergine, pale peach accent; type pairing serif-led: a high-contrast Traditional-Chinese serif for headlines with a quiet grotesk for body. This card's storytelling role is 「品牌 CTA」 and nothing else. Copy to set (Traditional Chinese, Taiwan usage):
Logo + 存檔提示
Show only the copy roles this role needs. This is the closing card: logo, one clear CTA and the hashtag line all belong here. Reserve 80 px of quiet space on the left and right edges: this card sits next to its siblings in a swipe, and anything touching the edge reads as sliced.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
No garbled, invented, mirrored or partially-rendered Chinese glyphs; no lorem ipsum, no placeholder squiggle standing in for text, no English filler where Traditional Chinese is specified. No watermark, signature, stock-photo mark, AI-tool badge or imitation of an existing brand, designer or publication. No nine-cards-on-one-canvas, no phone or device mockup, no drop-shadowed card floating on a coloured backdrop, no surrounding white canvas, no crop marks or safe-area guides. No text, logo or key subject inside the outer safe margin or crossing a slice seam. No heavy drop shadow, bevel, glossy gradient, neon glow, 3D extruded type or 2015-era template look. No more than two type families or three brand colours. No emoji, no unlicensed icon set, no chart with invented numbers presented as real data.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. Output ONE standalone card at the stated pixel size, edge to edge, with nothing outside the artboard.
2. Keep an 80 px safe margin on all four sides; the Instagram grid thumbnail crops a 4:5 card on both sides, so anything load-bearing sits centred and inside that margin.
3. The cover must be readable as a 160 px thumbnail: the hook needs one dominant line at 90 px or larger and a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against whatever is behind it.
4. Render only the copy roles this card is assigned. A card that does not need a logo, CTA or hashtag must not show one.
5. Use real, legible Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage) with punctuation, and keep body text at 36 px or larger — a phone reader is holding this at arm's length.
6. Every component must stay visually separable for rebuilding in Canva: text block, photo or diagram frame, decorative element, page number. Do not print layer-instruction labels on the card.
7. Hold the set's brand grammar — palette, type pairing, margin, decorative device — while changing composition and information density from card to card.
8. Body copy must be replaceable: no text baked into a photograph, no headline whose meaning depends on a decorative shape that cannot be moved.

items.purpose: 9 張連續背景帶
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create ONE wide, seamless, TEXT-FREE background plate for an Instagram carousel. It will be machine-split into 9 separate 3:4 cards of 1080×1440 px, so compose it as one continuous horizontal strip that reads left to right (final strip size 9720×1440). Output the widest aspect ratio this tool supports — 16:9 is fine; the strip is fitted afterwards. TEMPLATE FAMILY list-stack｜列表款. Design grammar: numbered stack layout, oversized numerals as the dominant graphic, one rule line per item, generous left margin. CONTINUOUS STRUCTURE — this is the whole point of the plate: a continuous vertical rule running the full height near the left third, crossed by evenly spaced horizontal hairlines, with a wide calm field to the right for numbering and text. Colourway cool-editorial: cool off-white, deep navy, soft slate blue accent. Surface soft-glaze: a soft glazed sheen with gentle highlight falloff and no harsh reflection. Every 1080 px along the strip is a cut line: keep the design either continuous across those cuts or clear of them, and never place a self-contained motif so that it straddles one. Leave broad calm areas with no detail — headlines, body copy and logos are typeset in Canva on top of this plate, and they need somewhere quiet to land.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
NO TEXT OF ANY KIND — no letters, words, numbers, page numbers, headlines, captions, labels, lorem ipsum, fake glyphs, handwriting or signage in any language. No logo, watermark, signature or AI-tool badge. No human figure, face, hand, animal or recognizable branded product. No card borders, frames, crop marks, seam guides, gutters, drop-shadowed panels or anything that reads as a divided grid of separate cards. No phone mockup, no presentation slide, no surrounding canvas. NO PHOTOGRAPHY ANYWHERE ON THE PLATE — no photographic landscape, interior, sky, foliage, texture photo or photo-realistic fill, not even faint, tinted, cropped inside a frame or used as a corner accent. Photo windows must be left EMPTY: draw the frame outline only and leave the inside as the plain paper ground. Photographs are placed in Canva afterwards at full resolution, because the plate is stretched to fit the strip afterwards and any photograph in it smears into pulp. No high-detail focal subject and no illustrated centrepiece — a plate is a stage, not a picture. No hard vignette, heavy noise, neon glow or blown-out highlight that would fight typography.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. This plate is a background only. Text is typeset on top of it later, so more than half of the surface must stay quiet enough to read 36 px body copy against.
2. Compose as one continuous strip. Any structural element — rule, band, path, torn edge, gradient — must run unbroken from the left edge to the right edge.
3. Self-contained motifs must not straddle a cut line. Either repeat them on a rhythm that clears the cuts, or let the design be genuinely continuous instead.
4. Keep contrast low and even along the whole strip: a plate that is dark at one end and pale at the other produces cards that no longer look like a set.
5. Hold one palette and one texture for the entire plate. Colour variation is delivered as a separate colourway plate, not as drift inside one plate.
6. Output the widest aspect ratio the tool offers at the highest available resolution; the strip is fitted and cut afterwards by scripts/split_carousel.py.
7. Detail level matters more than pixel count here: the plate is stretched several times its generated width, which soft texture survives and fine structure does not.
8. PRE-COMPRESS THE GEOMETRY. You can only output about 2.25:1 but the strip is 6.75:1, so everything you draw is stretched roughly 3× wider afterwards. Draw every arch, frame, circle or motif THREE TIMES NARROWER than it should finally look — a tall narrow arch here becomes a correctly-proportioned arch on the card. Horizontal rules and bands are unaffected.
9. ONE MOTIF PER CARD, evenly spaced. If the set is N cards, place exactly N repeats across the strip, each centred in its own 1/N slice, so no card inherits a motif that has drifted off-centre or been split between two cards.
10. No vertical dividing rules between the repeats. A vertical line at a cut turns the swipe into a row of bordered panels, which is the one thing the plate must never look like.

items.purpose: 母圖 → 9 張卡片
items.text:
python3 scripts/split_carousel.py list-stack_cool-editorial.png --cards 9
→ 輸出 9 張 1080×1440 卡片 + `_seam_preview.png`。
先看 seam preview：紅帶是每個切點左右各 80px 的禁區，有裝飾或主體被切開就回頭改母圖，不要硬上。
母圖是抽象紋理才用預設 `--fit stretch`；若母圖有拱門、照片框、物件等可辨識結構，改用 `--fit cover`（保幾何但裁掉大部分高度）。

items.purpose: 可販售模板｜列表款
items.text: CANVA TEMPLATE SPEC｜列表款（list-stack）｜百搭 Kit｜列表款（N 個重點／N 個常見錯誤）. 1080×1440 px、9 個獨立頁面。設計語法：numbered stack layout, oversized numerals as the dominant graphic, one rule line per item, generous left margin。字型配對 editorial-mix：a display serif headline, a grotesk body, and small-caps labels。安全邊 80px，切點禁區左右各 80px。把分割出來的卡片當背景，文字全部用可編輯 Canva 文字重打，不要留任何燒進圖裡的字。圖層命名要讓買家看得懂：BACKGROUND / HEADLINE / BODY / LABEL / PHOTO FRAME / PAGE / LOGO / CTA。最多兩個字型家族、三個品牌色。⚠️ 字型只能用可外發的授權（Canva Pro 專屬字型不能用在要交付的模板）。⚠️ 說明書要寫兩句：上傳時把比例從預設 4:5 改成 3:4；要縮成 6–8 張時，優先刪「視覺停頓」與最後一個並列項，永遠保留封面與 CTA。存成 master design，每次客製前先複製，最後產出 Brand Template 連結交付。
